sections.title: Abstract
sections.originalMarkdown: Modern distributed key-value (KV) stores adopt replication for fault tolerance by distributing replicas of KV pairs across nodes. However, existing distributed KV stores often manage all replicas in the same index structure, thereby leading to significant I/O costs beyond the replication redundancy. We propose a notion called *replica decoupling*, which decouples the storage management of the primary and redundant copies of replicas, so as to not only mitigate the I/O costs in indexing, but also provide tunable performance. In particular, we design a novel two-layer log that enables tunable ordering for the redundant copies to achieve balanced read/write performance. We implement a distributed KV store prototype, DEPART, atop Cassandra. Experiments show that DEPART outperforms Cassandra in all performance aspects under various consistency levels and parameter settings. Specifically, under the eventual consistency setting, DEPART achieves up to 1.43×, 2.43×, 2.68×, and 1.44× throughput for writes, reads, scans, and updates, respectively.
sections.translationMarkdown: 现代分布式键值（KV）存储通过在不同节点之间分布 KV 对的副本，采用 replication 来实现容错。然而，现有分布式 KV 存储通常在同一个索引结构中管理所有副本，因此会产生超出 replication 冗余本身的显著 I/O 成本。我们提出了一个称为 *replica decoupling* 的概念，将副本的 primary copy 和 redundant copies 的存储管理解耦，从而不仅减轻索引中的 I/O 成本，还能提供可调的性能。具体而言，我们设计了一种新型 two-layer log，使 redundant copies 的顺序可调，以实现均衡的读写性能。我们在 Cassandra 之上实现了一个分布式 KV 存储原型 DEPART。实验表明，在不同一致性级别和参数设置下，DEPART 在各项性能指标上都优于 Cassandra。具体来说，在 eventual consistency 设置下，DEPART 的写入、读取、扫描和更新吞吐量最高分别达到 Cassandra 的 1.43×、2.43×、2.68× 和 1.44×。

sections.title: 1 Introduction
sections.originalMarkdown:
Key-value (KV) stores serve as essential building blocks in the storage infrastructure of modern data-intensive applications, such as web search [14, 31], social networking [57], photo stores [10], and cloud storage [25,37]. To support large-scale usage, KV stores are often deployed in a *distributed* manner by storing the data objects (in the form of KV pairs) across multiple nodes. Examples of distributed KV stores include BigTable [14], HBase [3], Dynamo [25], HyperDex [28], Cassandra [37], TiKV [50], and Riak [54].

Failures become prevalent in any large-scale deployment, so providing fault tolerance for distributed KV stores is critical. Replication remains the commonly used fault tolerance mechanism in modern distributed KV stores (including the examples listed above [3, 14, 25, 28, 37, 50, 54]). Specifically, for each KV pair issued by a user write, replication makes multiple exact copies (called *replicas*) and distributes the replicas across different nodes, so as to tolerate any node failure.

One subtlety is that each node internally stores all replicas in the same index structure; we call such an approach *uniform indexing*. For example, we have examined the codebases of various open-source distributed KV stores, including HBase [3], HyperDex [28], Cassandra [37], TiKV [50], and ScyllaDB [60], and they all adopt uniform indexing for replica management. In particular, they keep all replicas originated from different nodes in a *log-structured-merged tree (LSM-tree)* [48], a multi-level tree structure that supports efficient reads and writes of KV pairs and maintains sorted KV pairs in each level for efficient scans (or range queries) to consecutive ranges of KV pairs. They either build on local LSM-tree KV stores (e.g., HyperDex uses HyperLevelDB [27] and TiKV uses RocksDB [29]), or implement their own LSM-tree structures (e.g., in HBase and Cassandra).

Uniform indexing is simple to implement for replica management, but it also significantly degrades both the write and read performance. First, the LSM-tree performs frequent compaction operations that rewrite the currently stored KV pairs to maintain their sorted order in each level. Storing all replicas in the same LSM-tree exacerbates the write amplification beyond the replication redundancy. For example, when replication is disabled, the write amplifications of Cassandra and TiKV are 6.5× and 13.8×, respectively; however, under triple replication, the write amplifications reach 25.7× and 50.9× in Cassandra and TiKV, respectively, incurring more than three times in write amplification (§3.1). Also, as reading a KV pair needs to search multiple levels in the LSM-tree, uniform indexing amplifies the search space and exacerbates the read amplification as well. For example, under triple replication, the read amplification of Cassandra reaches 34.6× (§3.1).

Our insight is that instead of putting all replicas in the same index structure, if we use different index structures for managing the storage of different types of replicas, we not only mitigate the read/write amplifications by reducing the size of the index structure for each type of replicas, but also enable flexible storage management to adapt to different design trade-offs. We make a case by proposing *replica decoupling*, which decouples the storage management of the replicas of each KV pair based on the *primary copy* (i.e., the main replica of the KV pair) and the *redundant copies* (i.e., the remaining replicas of the KV pair aside the primary copy). We use the LSM-tree to manage the primary copies only, so as to preserve the design features of the LSM-tree but in a more lightweight manner; meanwhile, we use simpler but tunable index structures for the redundant copies to balance the read and write performance depending on the performance requirements.

In this paper, we design replica decoupling in DEPART, a novel distributed KV store that decouples the storage management of primary and redundant copies for fault tolerance. DEPART builds on Cassandra [37]. It supports lightweight differentiation of the primary and redundant copies of replicas on the critical I/O path, while keeping the existing data organization and configurable consistency features of Cassandra. While managing the primary copies in the LSM-tree, DEPART proposes a novel *two-layer log* to manage the redundant copies with tunable ordering for balanced read and write performance. Its idea is to issue batched writes for the redundant copies into an append-only *global log* for high write performance. It further splits the global log into multiple *local logs*. In particular, the ordering of KV pairs in each local log is tunable by a *single* parameter to balance the read and write performance for the redundant copies; for example, given a high read (or write) consistency level (i.e., the number of replicas to be read (or written) in a successful operation; see §2.3), the two-layer log can be tuned to favor for high read (or write) performance. The two-layer log also improves failure recovery performance, by organizing the KV pairs by different key ranges and limiting a recovery operation to access only the relevant range of KV pairs. Our contributions are summarized as follows.

- We analyze two state-of-the-art distributed KV stores, Cassandra and TiKV, and reveal their performance limitations due to uniform indexing for replicas.
- We design DEPART, which realizes replica decoupling and has several key design features: (i) lightweight differentiation of primary and redundant copies, (ii) a two-layer log design with tunable ordering of redundant copies, and (iii) a fast failure recovery implementation via parallelization.
- We implement DEPART atop Cassandra v3.11.4 [2]. Experiments show that DEPART outperforms Cassandra in various settings. For example, for the case of eventual consistency, DEPART achieves 1.43×, 2.43×, 2.68×, and 1.44× throughput gains over Cassandra in writes, reads, scans, and updates, respectively. DEPART also maintains its read and write performance gains under various consistency level configurations.

The source code of our DEPART prototype is available at: https://github.com/ustcadsl/depart.
sections.translationMarkdown:
键值（KV）存储是现代数据密集型应用存储基础设施中的重要构件，例如 web search [14, 31]、social networking [57]、photo stores [10] 和 cloud storage [25,37]。为了支持大规模使用，KV 存储通常以 *distributed* 方式部署，将数据对象（以 KV 对的形式）存储在多个节点上。分布式 KV 存储的例子包括 BigTable [14]、HBase [3]、Dynamo [25]、HyperDex [28]、Cassandra [37]、TiKV [50] 和 Riak [54]。

在任何大规模部署中，failure 都很常见，因此为分布式 KV 存储提供 fault tolerance 至关重要。Replication 仍然是现代分布式 KV 存储普遍采用的 fault tolerance 机制（包括上述例子 [3, 14, 25, 28, 37, 50, 54]）。具体而言，对于用户一次写入产生的每个 KV 对，replication 会创建多个完全相同的副本（称为 *replicas*），并将这些副本分布到不同节点上，从而容忍任意节点 failure。

其中一个容易被忽略的问题是，每个节点在内部都将所有 replicas 存储在同一个索引结构中；我们将这种方式称为 *uniform indexing*。例如，我们考察了 HBase [3]、HyperDex [28]、Cassandra [37]、TiKV [50] 和 ScyllaDB [60] 等多个开源分布式 KV 存储的代码库，发现它们都对副本管理采用 uniform indexing。具体而言，它们将源自不同节点的所有副本保存在 *log-structured-merged tree（LSM-tree）* [48] 中。LSM-tree 是一种多层树结构，支持高效地读写 KV 对，并在每一层维护有序的 KV 对，以便高效扫描（或对连续 KV 对范围执行 range query）。这些系统要么基于本地 LSM-tree KV 存储构建（例如，HyperDex 使用 HyperLevelDB [27]，TiKV 使用 RocksDB [29]），要么实现自己的 LSM-tree 结构（例如 HBase 和 Cassandra）。

Uniform indexing 易于实现副本管理，但也会显著降低读写性能。首先，LSM-tree 会频繁执行 compaction 操作，重写当前存储的 KV 对，以维持每一层中的有序性。将所有副本存储在同一个 LSM-tree 中，会使 write amplification 超出 replication 冗余本身所带来的程度。例如，在禁用 replication 时，Cassandra 和 TiKV 的 write amplification 分别为 6.5× 和 13.8×；然而，在 triple replication 下，Cassandra 和 TiKV 的 write amplification 分别达到 25.7× 和 50.9×，使 write amplification 增加到三倍以上（§3.1）。此外，由于读取一个 KV 对需要搜索 LSM-tree 的多个层级，uniform indexing 也扩大了搜索空间，加剧了 read amplification。例如，在 triple replication 下，Cassandra 的 read amplification 达到 34.6×（§3.1）。

我们的洞察是：如果不把所有 replicas 放在同一个索引结构中，而是使用不同的索引结构管理不同类型 replicas 的存储，就不仅可以通过减小每类 replicas 对应的索引结构规模来降低 read/write amplification，还能实现灵活的存储管理，以适应不同的设计权衡。为此，我们提出 *replica decoupling*：根据每个 KV 对的 *primary copy*（即 KV 对的主副本）和 *redundant copies*（即除 primary copy 之外的其余 KV 对副本），将这些 replicas 的存储管理解耦。我们只使用 LSM-tree 管理 primary copies，从而以更轻量的方式保留 LSM-tree 的设计特性；与此同时，我们为 redundant copies 使用更简单但可调的索引结构，以根据性能需求平衡读写性能。

本文在 DEPART 中设计了 replica decoupling。DEPART 是一种新型分布式 KV 存储，通过解耦 primary copies 和 redundant copies 的存储管理来实现 fault tolerance。DEPART 构建于 Cassandra [37] 之上。它在关键 I/O 路径上轻量地区分副本中的 primary copies 和 redundant copies，同时保留 Cassandra 现有的数据组织方式和可配置的一致性特性。在使用 LSM-tree 管理 primary copies 的同时，DEPART 提出了一种新型 *two-layer log*，通过可调的顺序管理 redundant copies，以实现均衡的读写性能。其思路是将针对 redundant copies 的批量写入写入一个只追加的 *global log*，从而获得较高的写入性能。随后，它进一步将 global log 划分为多个 *local logs*。具体而言，每个 local log 中 KV 对的顺序由一个 *single* 参数调节，以平衡 redundant copies 的读写性能；例如，当读（或写）consistency level 较高时（即一次成功操作中需要读取（或写入）的 replicas 数量；见 §2.3），可以调节 two-layer log，使其偏向于较高的读（或写）性能。two-layer log 还通过按照不同 key range 组织 KV 对，并将 recovery 操作限制在只访问相关 KV 对范围内，改善了 failure recovery 性能。我们的贡献总结如下。

- 我们分析了两个 state-of-the-art 分布式 KV 存储 Cassandra 和 TiKV，揭示了它们因对 replicas 采用 uniform indexing 而存在的性能局限。
- 我们设计了 DEPART，实现了 replica decoupling，并具备若干关键设计特性：（i）轻量地区分 primary copies 和 redundant copies；（ii）采用可调节 redundant copies 顺序的 two-layer log 设计；（iii）通过并行化实现快速 failure recovery。
- 我们在 Cassandra v3.11.4 [2] 之上实现了 DEPART。实验表明，DEPART 在多种设置下都优于 Cassandra。例如，在 eventual consistency 情况下，DEPART 在写入、读取、扫描和更新方面相对于 Cassandra 的吞吐量增益分别达到 1.43×、2.43×、2.68× 和 1.44×。在各种 consistency level 配置下，DEPART 也保持了读写性能优势。

DEPART 原型的源代码地址为：https://github.com/ustcadsl/depart。

sections.title: 2 Background
sections.originalMarkdown: We use Cassandra [37] (which serves as the baseline for our DEPART design) as an example to describe the background of a distributed KV store, including its storage architecture, I/O workflows, and consistency management.
sections.translationMarkdown: 我们以 Cassandra [37]（它是 DEPART 设计所使用的 baseline）为例，介绍分布式 KV 存储的背景知识，包括其存储架构、I/O workflow 和一致性管理。

sections.title: 2.1 Storage Architecture
sections.originalMarkdown:
**Data organization.** A distributed KV store partitions KV pairs across a cluster of nodes. In Cassandra, the KV pairs are partitioned based on *consistent hashing* [33], which has also been adopted by other production distributed KV stores [25, 41, 54, 60]. Consistent hashing associates the locations of all nodes with a *hash ring* and maps each KV pair deterministically to a node. Specifically, we consider a distributed KV store with $n$ physical nodes, each of which is associated with $v$ virtual nodes. It divides the hash ring into $n \times v$ ranges, each of which covers one of the virtual nodes. For example, as shown in Figure 1, there are $n = 5$ physical nodes (i.e., $N_0$ to $N_4$) with $v = 2$ virtual nodes each. The hash ring contains $2 \times 5 = 10$ ranges, say $(0 - 10)$, $(11 - 20)$, $\cdots$, $(91 - 100)$. Each of the ranges is associated with the nearest virtual node in the clockwise direction in the hash ring and the corresponding physical node; for example, both ranges $(0 - 10)$ and $(51 - 60)$ are assigned to $N_0$. For each KV pair, consistent hashing hashes the key to a location in the hash ring (e.g., using MurmurHash [6] in Cassandra). The KV pair is then stored in the corresponding physical node that is associated with the range.

Replication is commonly used in modern distributed KV stores [3, 14, 25, 28, 37, 50] for fault tolerance, by distributing the replicas of each KV pair across different nodes to protect against node failures. In Cassandra, replicas are stored in a sequence of nodes along the clockwise direction in the hash ring denoted by $N_i, N_{(i+1) \bmod n}, N_{(i+2) \bmod n}, \cdots$, where $0 \le i \le n - 1$ and $N_i$ (i.e., the first node in the node sequence) is the node to which the KV pair is hashed based on consistent hashing. We refer to the replica that is stored in $N_i$ as the *primary copy*, while referring to the remaining replicas that are stored in the successive physical nodes along the clockwise direction in the hash ring as the *redundant copies*.

**Figure 1: Storage architecture in Cassandra.**

**Internal storage with the LSM-tree.** Each node internally manages KV pairs with some index structure. In particular, the LSM-tree [48] is one of the most commonly used index structures in distributed KV stores, including Cassandra and others [3, 20, 28, 41, 50, 60]. An LSM-tree KV store organizes KV pairs in a multi-level tree and keeps KV pairs sorted by keys in each level, so as to support efficient reads, writes, and scans. As shown in Figure 1, the LSM-tree KV store maintains a tree-based index structure with multiple levels (denoted by $L_0, L_1, \cdots$) with an increasing capacity, in which each level stores the KV pairs in units of files called SSTables. It first appends the written KV pairs into an on-disk write-ahead log (WAL), and inserts them into an in-memory MemTable. When the MemTable is full, the LSM-tree KV store turns the MemTable to an immutable MemTable, which is flushed to the lowest level $L_0$ as an SSTable. When a lower level reaches a capacity limit, the LSM-tree KV store merges the KV pairs at the lower level into the next higher level via compaction. To keep the KV pairs in each level sorted, a compaction operation first reads the KV pairs from both levels, merges the sorted KV pairs, and writes back the sorted KV pairs. Thus, compaction incurs extra I/Os during writes, leading to write amplification. Also, since KV pairs are not sorted across different levels, reading a KV pair needs to search from the lowest level $L_0$ to the higher levels, leading to read amplification. Both write and read amplifications are shown to cause significant performance degradations in LSM-tree KV stores [12, 43, 51].

**Data organization（数据组织）。** 分布式 KV 存储将 KV 对划分到一个节点集群中。在 Cassandra 中，KV 对依据 *consistent hashing* [33] 进行划分，其他生产级分布式 KV 存储也采用了这种方法 [25, 41, 54, 60]。Consistent hashing 将所有节点的位置关联到一个 *hash ring*，并将每个 KV 对确定性地映射到一个节点。具体而言，考虑一个包含 $n$ 个 physical nodes 的分布式 KV 存储，每个 physical node 关联 $v$ 个 virtual nodes。它将 hash ring 划分为 $n \times v$ 个 range，每个 range 覆盖一个 virtual node。例如，如 Figure 1 所示，共有 $n = 5$ 个 physical nodes（即 $N_0$ 到 $N_4$），每个节点包含 $v = 2$ 个 virtual nodes。Hash ring 包含 $2 \times 5 = 10$ 个 range，即 $(0 - 10)$、$(11 - 20)$、$\cdots$、$(91 - 100)$。每个 range 都与 hash ring 中顺时针方向最近的 virtual node 及其对应的 physical node 关联；例如，range $(0 - 10)$ 和 $(51 - 60)$ 都分配给 $N_0$。对于每个 KV 对，consistent hashing 会将其 key hash 到 hash ring 上的某个位置（例如，Cassandra 使用 MurmurHash [6]）。随后，该 KV 对被存储在与该 range 关联的对应 physical node 中。

现代分布式 KV 存储通常使用 replication [3, 14, 25, 28, 37, 50] 来实现 fault tolerance，将每个 KV 对的 replicas 分布到不同节点上，以防止 node failure。在 Cassandra 中，replicas 按照 hash ring 的顺时针方向存储在一系列节点中，记为 $N_i, N_{(i+1) \bmod n}, N_{(i+2) \bmod n}, \cdots$，其中 $0 \le i \le n - 1$，而 $N_i$（即节点序列中的第一个节点）是依据 consistent hashing 对 KV 对执行 hash 后得到的节点。我们将存储在 $N_i$ 中的 replica 称为 *primary copy*，将沿 hash ring 顺时针方向存储在后续 physical nodes 中的其余 replicas 称为 *redundant copies*。

**Figure 1：Cassandra 中的存储架构。**

**Internal storage with the LSM-tree（使用 LSM-tree 的内部存储）。** 每个节点在内部使用某种索引结构管理 KV 对。具体而言，LSM-tree [48] 是分布式 KV 存储中最常用的索引结构之一，Cassandra 及其他系统都采用了它 [3, 20, 28, 41, 50, 60]。LSM-tree KV 存储将 KV 对组织成多层树，并在每一层按 key 对 KV 对排序，从而支持高效的读取、写入和扫描。如 Figure 1 所示，LSM-tree KV 存储维护一个基于树的索引结构，其中包含多个层级（记为 $L_0, L_1, \cdots$），层级容量逐渐增加；每一层以称为 SSTables 的文件为单位存储 KV 对。它首先将写入的 KV 对追加到磁盘上的 write-ahead log（WAL）中，并将它们插入内存中的 MemTable。当 MemTable 已满时，LSM-tree KV 存储会将 MemTable 转换为 immutable MemTable，并将其 flush 到最低层 $L_0$，形成一个 SSTable。当较低层达到容量上限时，LSM-tree KV 存储通过 compaction 将较低层的 KV 对合并到下一个更高层。为了保持每一层中 KV 对的有序性，compaction 操作首先从两个层级读取 KV 对，合并这些有序 KV 对，然后将排序后的 KV 对写回。因此，compaction 会在写入过程中产生额外 I/O，导致 write amplification。此外，由于不同层级之间的 KV 对并未排序，读取一个 KV 对时需要从最低层 $L_0$ 搜索到更高层级，从而产生 read amplification。已有研究表明，write amplification 和 read amplification 都会导致 LSM-tree KV 存储出现显著的性能下降 [12, 43, 51]。

sections.title: 2.2 I/O Workflows
sections.originalMarkdown:
**Write workflow.** Writing a KV pair in Cassandra works as follows. A client first randomly selects and connects to one of the nodes, called the coordinator and sends it the KV pair. The coordinator determines the nodes in which the primary and redundant copies are stored, based on consistent hashing. It then forwards the KV pairs to the nodes.

**Read workflow.** Reading a KV pair in Cassandra is similar to writing a KV pair and works as follows. The client first selects and contacts a coordinator. It issues the read request to the coordinator, which finds the nodes in which the replicas (regardless of primary and redundant copies) of the KV pair are stored. For load balancing, the coordinator prefers to read the KV pair from the nodes with low latencies, determined by the dynamic snitching module [5]. It then returns the KV pair to the client.
sections.translationMarkdown:
**Write workflow（写入工作流）。** 在 Cassandra 中写入一个 KV 对的过程如下：客户端首先随机选择一个节点并与其建立连接，该节点称为 coordinator，然后将 KV 对发送给它。Coordinator 根据 consistent hashing 确定 primary copy 和 redundant copies 所存储的节点，随后将 KV 对转发给这些节点。

**Read workflow（读取工作流）。** 在 Cassandra 中读取一个 KV 对的过程与写入类似，具体如下：客户端首先选择一个 coordinator 并与其联系。它向 coordinator 发出读取请求，coordinator 找到存储该 KV 对 replicas 的节点（不区分 primary copy 和 redundant copies）。为了实现负载均衡，coordinator 会优先从延迟较低的节点读取 KV 对，节点延迟由 dynamic snitching 模块 [5] 确定。随后，它将 KV 对返回给客户端。

sections.title: 2.3 Consistency Management
sections.originalMarkdown: Cassandra supports different consistency modes, e.g., strong consistency and eventual consistency. They are configured by tuning the replication factor (denoted by $k$), as well as the read consistency level (RCL) and the write consistency level (WCL). The replication factor $k$ is defined as the total number of replicas for fault tolerance. RCL and WCL are defined as the minimum numbers of replicas (regardless of primary or redundant copies) to be read and written by the coordinator to acknowledge the successful read and write operations, respectively. Both RCL and WCL are set as an integer from one to $k$. If WCL+RCL> k, then strong consistency is provided; if WCL+RCL ≤ k, then eventual consistency is provided. By default, both WCL and RCL are set to one in Cassandra.
sections.translationMarkdown: Cassandra 支持不同的一致性模式，例如 strong consistency 和 eventual consistency。通过调整 replication factor（记为 $k$）、read consistency level（RCL）以及 write consistency level（WCL）来配置这些模式。Replication factor $k$ 定义为实现 fault tolerance 所使用的 replicas 总数。RCL 和 WCL 分别定义为 coordinator 为确认一次读取和写入操作成功，所需读取和写入的最少 replicas 数量（不区分 primary copy 或 redundant copies）。RCL 和 WCL 都取 1 到 $k$ 之间的整数。如果 WCL+RCL> k，则提供 strong consistency；如果 WCL+RCL ≤ k，则提供 eventual consistency。在 Cassandra 中，WCL 和 RCL 默认都设置为 1。

sections.title: 3 Replica Decoupling
sections.originalMarkdown: To motivate replica decoupling, we describe the limitations of uniform indexing for managing all replicas in internal storage management (§3.1). We also describe the naïve replica decoupling designs to motivate our DEPART design (§3.2).
sections.translationMarkdown: 为了说明副本解耦的动机，我们介绍在内部存储管理中使用统一索引管理所有副本的局限性（§3.1）。我们还介绍朴素的副本解耦设计，以此引出 DEPART 的设计（§3.2）。

sections.title: 3.1 Uniform Indexing and its Limitations
sections.originalMarkdown:
Recall from §1 that existing distributed KV stores (e.g., [3,28,37,50]) mainly adopt uniform indexing, in which all replicas (including all primary and redundant copies) designated for each node are managed under the same index structure. We show that uniform indexing, rather than the extra writes from replication, is the main cause of significantly exacerbating both the write and read amplifications of the LSM-tree.

Figure 2: Write amplifications of no-replication (“No”), double replication (“double”), and triple replication (“triple”) in Cassandra and TiKV.

Figure 3: Read amplifications of no-replication (“No”), double replication (“double”), and triple replication (“triple”) in Cassandra and TiKV.
sections.translationMarkdown:
回顾 §1，现有的分布式 KV store（例如 [3,28,37,50]）主要采用统一索引：为每个节点指定的所有副本（包括所有 primary copy 和 redundant copy）都由同一个索引结构管理。我们将展示，与复制带来的额外写入相比，统一索引才是显著加剧 LSM-tree 写放大和读放大的主要原因。

图 2：Cassandra 和 TiKV 在不复制（“No”）、双副本（“double”）和三副本（“triple”）下的写放大。

图 3：Cassandra 和 TiKV 在不复制（“No”）、双副本（“double”）和三副本（“triple”）下的读放大。

sections.title: Limitation #1: Write amplification aggravation
sections.originalMarkdown:
With uniform indexing, each node treats all replicas as the regular KV pairs and stores them in the same LSM-tree without distinction (Figure 1). To show how it exacerbates the write amplification, we evaluate the write amplifications of two open-source distributed KV stores, Cassandra (v3.11.4) [2] and TiKV (release 4.0) [50]. Specifically, we deploy Cassandra and TiKV on a 5-node cluster with their default settings (detailed in §5). We configure a client machine to issue the writes of 300 M KV pairs of size 1 KiB each to the cluster that initially has empty storage. We consider no-replication (k = 1), double replication (k = 2), and triple replication (k = 3). Figure 2(a) shows that no-replication incurs a write amplification of 6.5× for Cassandra, due to the compaction overhead caused by the LSM-tree. However, for triple replication, the write amplification increases to 25.7×, which is around 4× the write amplification of no-replication. We also observe a similar trend for TiKV, where the write amplification increases from 13.8× to 50.9× (i.e., 3.7× increase).

Also, as the KV store size increases, the write amplification increases more significantly and shows a super-linear trend. The reason is that a larger KV store size increases the number of levels in the LSM-tree, leading to higher compaction overhead and a larger write amplification. We configure a client machine to issue the writes of 100 M, 300 M, and 600 M KV pairs of size 1 KiB each to the initially empty cluster. Here, we focus on Cassandra. Figure 2(b) shows the write amplifications of Cassandra for different KV store sizes. For a larger data store, the increase of the write amplification under triple replication compared to no replication also becomes larger. For example, triple replication has 3.4× write amplification compared to no replication under 100 M KV pairs, and becomes 4.5× under 600 M KV pairs. This super-linear trend also implies that a larger KV store size can limit the scalability of uniform indexing.
sections.translationMarkdown:
在统一索引下，每个节点将所有副本都视为普通 KV pair，不加区分地存储在同一个 LSM-tree 中（图 1）。为了展示它如何加剧写放大，我们评估了两个开源分布式 KV store——Cassandra（v3.11.4）[2] 和 TiKV（4.0 版本）[50]——的写放大。具体而言，我们使用默认设置（详见 §5）将 Cassandra 和 TiKV 部署在一个 5 节点集群上。我们配置一台客户端机器，向初始存储为空的集群写入 300 M 个大小为 1 KiB 的 KV pair。我们考察不复制（k = 1）、双副本（k = 2）和三副本（k = 3）。图 2(a) 显示，由于 LSM-tree 带来的 compaction 开销，Cassandra 在不复制时的写放大为 6.5×。然而，在三副本下，写放大增加到 25.7×，约为不复制时的 4 倍。TiKV 也呈现出类似趋势，其写放大从 13.8× 增加到 50.9×（即增加 3.7 倍）。

此外，随着 KV store 大小增加，写放大的增长更加明显，并呈现超线性趋势。这是因为更大的 KV store 会增加 LSM-tree 中的层数，从而带来更高的 compaction 开销和更大的写放大。我们配置客户端机器向初始为空的集群写入 100 M、300 M 和 600 M 个大小为 1 KiB 的 KV pair。这里我们关注 Cassandra。图 2(b) 展示了不同 KV store 大小下 Cassandra 的写放大。对于更大的数据存储，与不复制相比，三副本导致的写放大增幅也更大。例如，在 100 M 个 KV pair 下，三副本相对于不复制的写放大为 3.4×；在 600 M 个 KV pair 下则增至 4.5×。这种超线性趋势还表明，更大的 KV store 大小会限制统一索引的可扩展性。

sections.title: Limitation #2: Read amplification aggravation
sections.originalMarkdown:
Uniform indexing also severely exacerbates the read amplification. The main reason is that all replicas are stored in the same LSM-tree, thereby enlarging the search space of KV pairs. We evaluate the read amplifications of Cassandra and TiKV as in the above settings, while a client machine issues 30 M reads to the existing 300 M KV pairs of size 1 KiB each that have already been stored. Figure 3(a) shows that for Cassandra, the read amplification increases from 7.8× in no-replication to 34.6× in triple replication (i.e., 4.4× increase). We observe a similar trend for TiKV.

In addition, we study the impact of the KV store size on the read amplification. Here, we focus on Cassandra. We first issue the writes of 100 M, 300 M, and 600 M KV pairs of size 1 KiB each to the initially empty cluster, followed by issuing 30 M reads to the existing KV pairs. Figure 3(b) shows a super-linear increase for the read amplification as the KV store size increases for Cassandra.
sections.translationMarkdown:
统一索引还会严重加剧读放大。主要原因是所有副本都存储在同一个 LSM-tree 中，从而扩大了 KV pair 的搜索空间。我们在上述设置下评估 Cassandra 和 TiKV 的读放大，同时让客户端机器对已经存储的 300 M 个、每个大小为 1 KiB 的 KV pair 发出 30 M 次读取。图 3(a) 显示，对于 Cassandra，读放大从不复制时的 7.8× 增加到三副本时的 34.6×（即增加 4.4 倍）。TiKV 也呈现出类似趋势。

此外，我们研究 KV store 大小对读放大的影响。这里我们关注 Cassandra。我们首先向初始为空的集群写入 100 M、300 M 和 600 M 个大小为 1 KiB 的 KV pair，随后对已有 KV pair 发出 30 M 次读取。图 3(b) 显示，对于 Cassandra，随着 KV store 大小增加，读放大呈现超线性增长。

sections.title: 3.2 Motivation
sections.originalMarkdown: Our analysis in §3.1 shows that uniform indexing exacerbates both write and read amplifications, as it is costly to manage all replicas within a single LSM-tree. This motivates us to explore the potentials of replica decoupling, which decouples the primary and redundant copies of replicas and manage them in separate index structures. We first consider two naïve replica decoupling approaches, and then motivate our design.
sections.translationMarkdown: §3.1 中的分析表明，统一索引在单个 LSM-tree 中管理所有副本的代价很高，因此会加剧写放大和读放大。这促使我们探索副本解耦的潜力：将副本中的 primary copy 和 redundant copy 解耦，并使用独立的索引结构管理它们。我们首先考察两种朴素的副本解耦方法，然后引出我们的设计。

sections.title: Naïve approaches
sections.originalMarkdown:
A simple replica decoupling approach is to deploy two LSM-trees, one for primary copies and one for all redundant copies. However, the LSM-tree for redundant copies still has a large size (especially for a large replication factor), while not all redundant copies are accessed in each I/O operation. For example, to recover a single-node failure under triple replication, only half of the redundant copies on average are accessed. Thus, there are extra I/Os for searching the whole LSM-tree for a subset of redundant copies.

Another simple replica decoupling approach is to manage k LSM-trees (k is the replication factor) for k replicas derived from each KV pair. For example, for Cassandra with triple replication, node N_i receives the redundant copies whose corresponding primary copies are stored in nodes N_(i−1) mod n and N_(i−2) mod n (where 0 ≤ i ≤ n − 1 and n is the number of physical nodes). Then we use three LSM-trees in node N_i, one of which stores the primary copies and the other two store the redundant copies from nodes N_(i−1) mod n and N_(i−2) mod n, respectively.

However, maintaining multiple LSM-trees incurs both significant memory and I/O overheads. Since each LSM-tree has its own MemTable and immutable MemTable, the memory overhead amplifies by k times for the replication factor k. Specifically, if the MemTable size is m MiB and the cluster size is n, the memory cost of Cassandra is m × n MiB as each node maintains a single LSM-tree. However, when using k LSM-trees in each node, the memory cost becomes k × m × n MiB, which is k times that in Cassandra. Note that if we reduce the MemTable size for each LSM-tree to limit the memory overhead, it degrades the efficiency of flushing the MemTable to disk, thereby degrading the user write performance [7, 8].

Also, each LSM-tree incurs its own compaction overhead for maintaining the fully-sorted ordering in each level. Thus, the compaction overhead is still significant and the compaction operations of multiple LSM-trees in the same node compete for the disk bandwidth, and hence the overall I/O performance is compromised. Our evaluation (Exp#1 in §5.2) shows that replica decoupling with multiple LSM-trees only brings limited performance gains over uniform indexing, even though the replicas are managed by different LSM-trees.
sections.translationMarkdown:
一种简单的副本解耦方法是部署两个 LSM-tree：一个用于 primary copy，另一个用于所有 redundant copy。然而，redundant copy 对应的 LSM-tree 仍然很大（尤其是在 replication factor 较大时），而且每次 I/O 操作并不需要访问所有 redundant copy。例如，在三副本下恢复单节点故障时，平均只会访问一半的 redundant copy。因此，为了从整个 LSM-tree 中搜索 redundant copy 的一个子集，会产生额外的 I/O。

另一种简单的副本解耦方法是针对每个 KV pair 派生出的 k 个副本，使用 k 个 LSM-tree 进行管理（k 是 replication factor）。例如，对于三副本 Cassandra，节点 N_i 接收 redundant copy，而这些 copy 对应的 primary copy 存储在节点 N_(i−1) mod n 和 N_(i−2) mod n 中（其中 0 ≤ i ≤ n − 1，n 是物理节点数）。于是，我们在节点 N_i 中使用三个 LSM-tree：其中一个存储 primary copy，另外两个分别存储来自节点 N_(i−1) mod n 和 N_(i−2) mod n 的 redundant copy。

然而，维护多个 LSM-tree 会带来显著的内存和 I/O 开销。由于每个 LSM-tree 都有自己的 MemTable 和 immutable MemTable，对于 replication factor k，内存开销会放大 k 倍。具体而言，如果 MemTable 大小为 m MiB、集群大小为 n，那么 Cassandra 的内存成本为 m × n MiB，因为每个节点只维护一个 LSM-tree。但是，当每个节点使用 k 个 LSM-tree 时，内存成本变为 k × m × n MiB，是 Cassandra 中的 k 倍。需要注意的是，如果减小每个 LSM-tree 的 MemTable 大小以限制内存开销，就会降低将 MemTable flush 到磁盘的效率，进而降低用户写性能 [7, 8]。

此外，每个 LSM-tree 都会产生自身的 compaction 开销，以维护各层中的完全有序性。因此，compaction 开销仍然很大；同一节点中的多个 LSM-tree 还会竞争磁盘带宽，从而损害整体 I/O 性能。我们的评估（§5.2 的实验 1）表明，即使副本由不同的 LSM-tree 管理，使用多个 LSM-tree 进行副本解耦相对于统一索引也只能带来有限的性能收益。

sections.title: Our approach
sections.originalMarkdown: Recall that the LSM-tree always maintains the fully-sorted ordering in each level. Using a single LSM-tree for all replicas in uniform indexing, or using multiple LSM-trees for replica decoupling, may favor high read performance, but both of them incur substantial high compaction overhead that degrades write performance. In particular, different consistency levels imply different performance requirements for the reads and writes issued to the replicas, such that a high read (or write) consistency level requires high read (or write) performance for the replicas. This motivates us to design a new storage management solution that supports tunable ordering for replica decoupling, so as to balance the read and write performance.
sections.translationMarkdown: 回顾一下，LSM-tree 始终维护每一层中的完全有序性。在统一索引中使用单个 LSM-tree 管理所有副本，或者在副本解耦中使用多个 LSM-tree，可能有利于获得较高的读性能，但两者都会产生很高的 compaction 开销，从而降低写性能。特别是，不同的一致性级别意味着对副本执行的读写有不同的性能要求：较高的读（或写）一致性级别要求副本具有较高的读（或写）性能。这促使我们设计一种支持可调有序性的全新存储管理方案，用于副本解耦，从而平衡读写性能。

sections.title: 4 DEPART Design
sections.originalMarkdown: We present DEPART, a distributed KV store that builds on Cassandra to realize replica decoupling by separating the storage management of primary and redundant copies. We introduce its architecture (§4.1) and elaborate its design techniques (§4.2-§4.5).
sections.translationMarkdown: 我们介绍 DEPART，这是一个构建于 Cassandra 之上的分布式 KV store，通过分离 primary copy 和 redundant copy 的存储管理来实现副本解耦。我们介绍其架构（§4.1），并详细阐述其设计技术（§4.2–§4.5）。

sections.title: 4.1 Overall Architecture
sections.originalMarkdown:
DEPART decouples the storage management of primary and redundant copies to achieve high performance. It manages the primary copies in the LSM-tree, while managing the redundant copies in a novel two-layer log, whose ordering of redundant copies is tunable depending on the performance requirements. Keeping only the primary copies in the LSM-tree maintains the design features of the LSM-tree for reads, writes, and scans, but in a more lightweight manner as the LSM-tree size is now significantly smaller without the redundant copies. Also, the tunable ordering of the two-layer log allows balanced read and write performance for different settings of consistency levels.

Figure 4: DEPART architecture.
sections.translationMarkdown:
DEPART 将 primary copy 和 redundant copy 的存储管理解耦，以实现高性能。它在 LSM-tree 中管理 primary copy，同时在一种新颖的 two-layer log 中管理 redundant copy；redundant copy 的有序程度可以根据性能需求进行调节。LSM-tree 只保存 primary copy，仍能保留 LSM-tree 在读、写和 scan 方面的设计特性，同时由于去除了 redundant copy，LSM-tree 的规模显著减小，因而更加轻量。此外，two-layer log 的可调有序性能够在不同一致性级别设置下平衡读写性能。

图 4：DEPART 架构。

sections.title: 4.2 Replica Differentiation
sections.originalMarkdown:
DEPART differentiates the written KV pairs in the storage module of each node as primary or redundant copies. Figure 5 depicts the replica differentiation workflow. Recall that the coordinator forwards k replicas of a KV pair to a sequence of k nodes along the clockwise direction in the hash ring, where the key of the KV pair is hashed to the first node in the node sequence (§2). When a node, say N, receives one of the replicas of the KV pair from the coordinator, it performs the same hash computation (i.e., MurmurHash [6] in Cassandra) on the key of the replica¹ and determines the node to which the key is hashed. If the resulting node is the same as N itself, then N is the first node in the node sequence and we refer to the replica as a primary copy; otherwise, we refer to the replica as a redundant copy.

Each node maintains a write-ahead log (WAL) and a MemTable for the LSM-tree (for primary copies) and the two-layer log (for redundant copies). After a node differentiates whether the KV pair is a primary copy or a redundant copy, it writes the KV pair to the corresponding WAL and MemTable and acknowledges the coordinator. When the MemTable is full and becomes immutable, the node flushes the immutable MemTable to either the LSM-tree or the two-layer log.

The logic of replica differentiation is lightweight, as it requires one extra hash computation in each storage node in the critical I/O path (and k extra computations in total for the replication factor k). Our experiments show that the differentiation time is less than 0.4% of the total write time (Exp#5 in §5.2).

Figure 5: Replica differentiation in DEPART.
sections.translationMarkdown:
DEPART 在每个节点的存储模块中，将写入的 KV pair 区分为 primary copy 或 redundant copy。图 5 描述了副本区分流程。回顾 §2，coordinator 会沿 hash ring 的顺时针方向，将一个 KV pair 的 k 个副本转发给连续的 k 个节点，其中该 KV pair 的 key 会被 hash 到节点序列中的第一个节点。当某个节点（例如 N）从 coordinator 接收到该 KV pair 的一个副本时，它会对该副本的 key 执行相同的 hash 计算（即 Cassandra 中的 MurmurHash [6]）¹，并确定该 key 被 hash 到的节点。如果得到的节点就是 N 本身，那么 N 是节点序列中的第一个节点，我们将该副本称为 primary copy；否则称为 redundant copy。

每个节点为 LSM-tree（用于 primary copy）和 two-layer log（用于 redundant copy）分别维护一个 write-ahead log（WAL）和一个 MemTable。节点区分出 KV pair 是 primary copy 还是 redundant copy 后，会将该 KV pair 写入相应的 WAL 和 MemTable，并向 coordinator 确认。当 MemTable 已满并变为 immutable 时，节点会将 immutable MemTable flush 到 LSM-tree 或 two-layer log 中。

副本区分逻辑很轻量，因为在关键 I/O 路径上，每个存储节点只需额外执行一次 hash 计算（对于 replication factor k，总共额外执行 k 次计算）。实验表明，区分所需时间不到总写入时间的 0.4%（§5.2 的实验 5）。

图 5：DEPART 中的副本区分。

sections.title: 4.3 Two-layer Log Design
sections.originalMarkdown:
Each node maintains a two-layer log, which is designed for the management of redundant copies with the following design features. First, it supports fast writes for the redundant copies, even though the number of redundant copies is much larger than that of primary copies and increases with the replication factor. Second, it supports tunable ordering to adapt to different consistency levels (§4.4). Third, it supports efficient parallel recovery of any failed nodes by allowing fast reads to the redundant copies in parallel.

Figure 6 shows the architecture of the two-layer log in each node. Upon receiving the replicas, a node first issues sequential batched writes for the redundant copies into a global log. A background thread continuously retrieves the redundant copies from the global log and splits them into multiple local logs. We elaborate the global log and local log designs below.

Figure 6: Architecture of the two-layer log design.
sections.translationMarkdown:
每个节点都维护一个 two-layer log，用于管理 redundant copy，并具有以下设计特性。第一，即使 redundant copy 的数量远多于 primary copy，并且会随 replication factor 增大，它仍支持对 redundant copy 进行快速写入。第二，它支持可调有序性，以适应不同的一致性级别（§4.4）。第三，它允许并行快速读取 redundant copy，从而支持对任意故障节点进行高效的并行恢复。

图 6 展示了每个节点中 two-layer log 的架构。节点收到副本后，首先将 redundant copy 以顺序批量写入 global log。后台线程持续从 global log 中取出 redundant copy，并将其拆分到多个 local log 中。下面详细介绍 global log 和 local log 的设计。

图 6：two-layer log 设计的架构。

sections.title: Append-only global log
sections.originalMarkdown:
To enable fast writes, each node writes all redundant copies of KV pairs (flushed from the immutable MemTable) to an append-only global log. All redundant copies are grouped in units of segments and appended to the head of the global log as sequential batched writes. Note that the global log only stores all redundant copies without maintaining any extra index structure. Thus, it achieves high write performance for the redundant copies.

Keeping all redundant copies in the global log achieves high write performance, but poses two issues. First, the recovery performance degrades. For the redundant copies in the global log, their corresponding primary copies may reside in different nodes. When a node failure happens, only part of the redundant copies in the global log (i.e., the redundant copies whose corresponding primary copies reside in the failed node) are needed for recovery. Thus, recovery incurs only partial access to the global log, thereby incurring lots of random I/Os. Second, the garbage collection cost increases. As new KV pairs are appended to the log head, invalid (or stale) KV pairs cannot be overwritten and hence they occupy lots of space. This incurs large storage overhead, especially in update-intensive workloads. Garbage collection can be used to reduce the storage cost by continuously reclaiming the free space of invalid KV pairs from the log tail, but it inevitably introduces large amount of extra I/Os to read segments from the log tail and write back the valid KV pairs to the log head.
sections.translationMarkdown:
为了实现快速写入，每个节点将 KV pair 的所有 redundant copy（从 immutable MemTable flush 出来）写入只追加的 global log。所有 redundant copy 以 segment 为单位分组，并通过顺序批量写入追加到 global log 的头部。需要注意的是，global log 只存储所有 redundant copy，不维护任何额外的索引结构。因此，它能够为 redundant copy 实现较高的写性能。

将所有 redundant copy 保存在 global log 中可以获得较高的写性能，但会带来两个问题。第一，恢复性能会下降。对于 global log 中的 redundant copy，其对应的 primary copy 可能位于不同节点。当节点发生故障时，恢复只需要 global log 中的一部分 redundant copy（即对应 primary copy 位于故障节点的 redundant copy）。因此，恢复只能对 global log 进行部分访问，从而产生大量随机 I/O。第二，垃圾回收成本会增加。新的 KV pair 被追加到 log 头部后，无效（或过时）的 KV pair 无法被覆盖，因此会占用大量空间。这会带来很大的存储开销，尤其是在更新密集型工作负载下。可以通过持续从 log 尾部回收无效 KV pair 所占的空闲空间来降低存储成本，但这不可避免地会产生大量额外 I/O：既要从 log 尾部读取 segment，又要将有效 KV pair 写回 log 头部。

sections.title: Splitting into local logs
sections.originalMarkdown:
To enable fast recovery, DEPART maintains a background thread to continuously split the global log into multiple local logs, each of which keeps only the redundant copies whose corresponding primary copies are stored in the same node. This allows the recovery of any failed node to access only the local log associated with the failed node. Note that each node only needs to maintain k − 1 local logs (recall that k is the replication factor), since consistent hashing distributes the replicas in a sequence of nodes along the clockwise direction in the hash ring and each node only stores a redundant copy from up to k − 1 nodes.

The splitting operation works as follows: it first retrieves a configurable number of segments, collectively called a split, from the tail of the global log. It then reorganizes a split of redundant copies into multiple sub-splits, each of which contains only the redundant copies whose corresponding primary copies reside in the same node. It finally writes back each sub-split into a separate local log in an append-only manner, and issues the writes to different local logs in parallel.

During splitting, DEPART also discards any invalid KV pairs in the selected segments. Thus, it does not trigger garbage collection explicitly; instead, it realizes garbage collection in the splitting operation to save the extra I/Os. For each redundant copy, each node needs to determine the node in which its corresponding primary copy resides. It can be feasibly done locally within a node based on replica differentiation (§4.2).
sections.translationMarkdown:
为了实现快速恢复，DEPART 维护一个后台线程，持续将 global log 拆分为多个 local log；每个 local log 只保存对应 primary copy 存储在同一节点中的 redundant copy。这样，恢复任意故障节点时，只需访问与该故障节点关联的 local log。注意，每个节点只需维护 k − 1 个 local log（回顾一下，k 是 replication factor），因为 consistent hashing 会沿 hash ring 的顺时针方向将副本分布在节点序列中，并且每个节点最多只保存来自 k − 1 个节点的 redundant copy。

拆分操作如下：首先，从 global log 的尾部取出可配置数量的 segment，这些 segment 合起来称为一个 split。然后，将一个 split 中的 redundant copy 重新组织为多个 sub-split，每个 sub-split 只包含对应 primary copy 位于同一节点中的 redundant copy。最后，以只追加的方式将每个 sub-split 写回单独的 local log，并行地向不同 local log 发起写入。

在拆分期间，DEPART 还会丢弃所选 segment 中的无效 KV pair。因此，它不会显式触发垃圾回收；相反，它在拆分操作中完成垃圾回收，以节省额外的 I/O。对于每个 redundant copy，每个节点都需要确定其对应 primary copy 所在的节点。基于副本区分（§4.2），这一过程可以在节点本地高效完成。

sections.title: Range-based grouping within local logs
sections.titleTranslation: local log 中基于范围的分组
sections.originalMarkdown:
While splitting the global log into multiple local logs alleviates the recovery and garbage collection overhead, the benefit remains limited since the ranges of a hash ring stored in each node are not necessarily contiguous (e.g., in Figure 1, Node N0 stores ranges [0,10] and [51,60]). Recovering any range of KV pairs only needs to access the redundant copies for the range, so it still causes partial accesses to a local log and issues random I/Os.

We enhance each local log by managing KV pairs with range-based grouping. Figure 7 shows the idea of range-based grouping. Each local log is further divided into multiple range groups, each of which corresponds to a range in the hash ring. Note that different range groups within each local log have no overlaps in keys, so they can be managed independently. For example, for Node N2 in Figure 7, the local log LOG0 stores the redundant copies whose corresponding primary copies reside in Node N0. As Node N0 has two ranges, [0,10] and [51,60], LOG0 now contains two range groups, each of which holds the redundant copies for [0,10] and [51,60], respectively.

Range-based grouping can be realized by comparing the keys (or their hashes) with the boundary of each range in the hash ring based on consistent hashing (§2.1). It still ensures that the writes to each range group in a local log are performed in an append-only, batched manner. The number of range groups in a local log, and hence the number of ranges in Cassandra, are configurable by the parameter num_tokens [2]. Range-based grouping improves the recovery performance by accessing only the KV pairs in the corresponding range groups without accessing all KV pairs in the whole local log.

Under range-based grouping, when writing KV pairs from the global log to the local logs during a splitting operation, DEPART further sorts all KV pairs by keys for each range before storing the KV pairs in a range group in the local logs; we call the sorted KV pairs for a range in a splitting operation a sorted run. Thus, each range group may store multiple sorted runs, while different sorted runs in the same range group may have overlaps in keys. Managing the range groups by sorted runs makes tunable ordering feasible (§4.4).

Figure 7: Range-based grouping within local logs.
sections.translationMarkdown:
虽然将 global log 拆分为多个 local log 可以减轻恢复和垃圾回收开销，但由于每个节点存储的 hash ring 范围不一定连续，收益仍然有限（例如，图 1 中的节点 N0 存储范围 [0,10] 和 [51,60]）。恢复任意一个 KV pair 范围时，只需访问该范围对应的 redundant copy，因此仍然需要对 local log 进行部分访问，并产生随机 I/O。

我们进一步使用基于范围的分组来管理 KV pair，从而增强每个 local log。图 7 展示了基于范围分组的思想。每个 local log 进一步划分为多个 range group，每个 range group 对应 hash ring 中的一个范围。注意，同一个 local log 中不同 range group 的 key 互不重叠，因此可以独立管理。例如，对于图 7 中的节点 N2，local log LOG0 保存对应 primary copy 位于节点 N0 中的 redundant copy。由于节点 N0 有两个范围 [0,10] 和 [51,60]，LOG0 现在包含两个 range group，分别保存 [0,10] 和 [51,60] 对应的 redundant copy。

基于范围的分组可以通过根据 consistent hashing（§2.1），将 key（或其 hash 值）与 hash ring 中每个范围的边界进行比较来实现。它仍然保证 local log 中每个 range group 的写入以只追加、批量的方式执行。local log 中 range group 的数量，以及 Cassandra 中范围的数量，都可以通过参数 num_tokens [2] 配置。基于范围的分组通过只访问对应 range group 中的 KV pair，而不访问整个 local log 中的全部 KV pair，提升了恢复性能。

在基于范围的分组下，拆分操作期间将 KV pair 从 global log 写入 local log 时，DEPART 会先对每个范围内的所有 KV pair 按 key 进一步排序，然后再将 KV pair 存储到 local log 的 range group 中；我们将一次拆分操作中某个范围内排好序的 KV pair 称为一个 sorted run。因此，每个 range group 可能保存多个 sorted run，而同一个 range group 中不同 sorted run 的 key 可能存在重叠。以 sorted run 管理 range group，使得可调有序性成为可能（§4.4）。

图 7：local log 中基于范围的分组。

sections.title: Reads from the two-layer log
sections.originalMarkdown: To read a KV pair from the two-layer log, DEPART first checks the segments in the global log one by one, starting with the latest one. Note that the internal structure of each segment is similar to that of SSTables in the LSM-tree, so DEPART first reads the metadata from the segment and reads the corresponding KV pair according to the offset in the metadata. If the KV pair is not found in the global log, then DEPART searches the corresponding range group, located by comparing the key with the boundary keys of the range groups. Since each range group contains multiple sorted runs and KV pairs within the sorted run are fully sorted, DEPART searches from the latest to the oldest sorted run, and uses binary search to find the key within a sorted run.
sections.translationMarkdown: 为了从 two-layer log 中读取一个 KV pair，DEPART 首先从最新 segment 开始，逐个检查 global log 中的 segment。需要注意的是，每个 segment 的内部结构类似于 LSM-tree 中的 SSTable，因此 DEPART 首先读取 segment 的 metadata，再根据 metadata 中的 offset 读取对应的 KV pair。如果在 global log 中没有找到该 KV pair，DEPART 就会搜索对应的 range group；该 range group 通过将 key 与 range group 的边界 key 进行比较来定位。由于每个 range group 包含多个 sorted run，且 sorted run 内的 KV pair 已完全排序，DEPART 会从最新的 sorted run 搜索到最旧的 sorted run，并使用二分查找在 sorted run 内寻找该 key。

sections.title: 4.4 Tunable Ordering
sections.originalMarkdown:
Recall that each range group in a local log may contain multiple sorted runs, and the KV pairs across the sorted runs within a range group are not fully sorted. If a range group contains too many sorted runs, the read performance for the redundant copies will degrade, especially for high read consistency levels where both primary and redundant copies are accessed in a read operation (§2.3). Thus, we extend the two-layer log with a tunable ordering scheme, in which users can configure a single parameter to adjust the degree of ordering of each range group for different consistency requirements.

DEPART adjusts the degree of ordering across multiple sorted runs with a user-configurable threshold S, which is a positive integer that controls the maximum number of sorted runs being allowed to exist in each range group. Figure 8 shows the idea of the tunable ordering scheme. For each new sorted run generated from a splitting operation, DEPART first checks if the existing number of sorted runs in a range group reaches the threshold. If not, it appends the new sorted run from the splitting operation directly to the range group; otherwise, it merge-sorts the new sorted run with the existing ones into a single sorted run. The merge-sort operation is similar to the compaction operation in the LSM-tree, including three steps: (i) it reads all existing sorted runs from the range group; (ii) it merges all KV pairs in the new sorted run and the existing sorted runs, and if there exist multiple KV pairs with the same key in different sorted runs, it keeps only the KV pair in the latest sorted run and discards the older ones; and (iii) it writes back all merged KV pairs into the range group. We consider two special cases for different values of S.

• Case 1: S = 1. In this case, each range group always sorts the incoming sorted run with the currently stored sorted run, and hence all KV pairs are sorted. Thus, each local log resembles a single-level LSM-tree.
• Case 2: S approaches infinity. In this case, DEPART always appends the new sorted run into a range group without any merge-sorting with any existing sorted runs.

To set an appropriate value of S, we note that S determines the trade-off between the read and write performance. A small S favors the read performance by keeping a small number of sorted runs in a range group. It also maintains the storage efficiency by discarding the invalid KV pairs in merge-sort operations. However, it incurs a large merge-sort overhead that degrades the write performance. Thus, to support a system setting with the high read consistency level under read-dominant workloads, we should set a high degree of ordering with a small S to benefit reads; otherwise, we should decrease the degree of ordering by increasing the value of S to benefit writes. We also evaluate the impact of different values of S via experiments, and we recommend a default setting, S = 20, that can effectively balance the read and write performance under different consistency configurations (see Exp#8 in §5.2).

Figure 8: Tunable ordering.
sections.translationMarkdown:
回顾一下，local log 中的每个 range group 可能包含多个 sorted run，而一个 range group 内跨 sorted run 的 KV pair 并不是完全有序的。如果一个 range group 包含太多 sorted run，redundant copy 的读性能就会下降，尤其是在较高读一致性级别下，因为一次读取操作会同时访问 primary copy 和 redundant copy（§2.3）。因此，我们为 two-layer log 扩展了一种可调有序性方案，用户可以配置一个参数，根据不同的一致性要求调节每个 range group 的有序程度。

DEPART 使用用户可配置的阈值 S 调节多个 sorted run 之间的有序程度。S 是一个正整数，用于控制每个 range group 中允许存在的 sorted run 的最大数量。图 8 展示了可调有序性方案的思想。对于拆分操作生成的每个新 sorted run，DEPART 首先检查 range group 中现有 sorted run 的数量是否达到阈值。如果没有达到，就将拆分操作生成的新 sorted run 直接追加到 range group；否则，就将新的 sorted run 与已有 sorted run 进行归并排序，合并为一个 sorted run。归并排序操作类似于 LSM-tree 中的 compaction，包括三个步骤：(i) 读取 range group 中已有的所有 sorted run；(ii) 合并新 sorted run 和已有 sorted run 中的所有 KV pair；如果不同 sorted run 中存在多个 key 相同的 KV pair，则只保留最新 sorted run 中的 KV pair，并丢弃较旧的 KV pair；(iii) 将所有合并后的 KV pair 写回 range group。对于 S 的不同取值，我们考察两个特殊情况。

• 情况 1：S = 1。此时，每个 range group 总是将传入的 sorted run 与当前存储的 sorted run 进行排序，因此所有 KV pair 都是有序的。于是，每个 local log 都类似于一个单层 LSM-tree。
• 情况 2：S 趋近于无穷大。此时，DEPART 总是将新的 sorted run 追加到 range group 中，不与任何已有 sorted run 进行归并排序。

为了设置合适的 S，我们注意到 S 决定了读写性能之间的权衡。较小的 S 通过使 range group 中保持较少的 sorted run，有利于读性能。它还会在归并排序操作中丢弃无效 KV pair，从而保持存储效率。但是，它会产生较大的归并排序开销，降低写性能。因此，为了在读主导工作负载下、较高读一致性级别的系统设置中提供支持，我们应当使用较小的 S 来设置较高的有序程度，以获益于读取；否则，应当增大 S 以降低有序程度，从而获益于写入。我们还通过实验评估了不同 S 取值的影响，并推荐默认设置 S = 20；在不同一致性配置下，它能够有效平衡读写性能（见 §5.2 的实验 8）。

图 8：可调有序性。

sections.title: 4.5 Parallel Recovery
sections.originalMarkdown:
For fast recovery of any failed node, DEPART proposes a parallel recovery scheme that exploits the benefit of decoupling the storage management of primary and redundant copies. We first review the recovery process in the current Cassandra implementation. Cassandra currently does not have a centralized node to monitor data loss and coordinate data recovery. Instead, it maintains a Merkle tree [4, 47] in each node to detect data inconsistency among multiple copies. Note that Merkle trees are also used by other consistent-hashing-based distributed KV stores, such as Dynamo [25] and Riak [54].

A Merkle tree is a binary hash tree, in which each leaf node stores the hash value of a range of KV pairs, while each non-leaf node stores the hash value of its child nodes. If a KV pair is lost, the replicas of the KV pair become inconsistent as detected by the Merkle trees across the nodes that store the replicas, so Cassandra triggers a recovery process. Specifically, the recovery process has three steps: (i) building a Merkle tree for each range of KV pairs in each node; (ii) comparing the Merkle trees of the same range of KV pairs in different nodes to identify any inconsistent range of KV pairs (which implies data loss); and (iii) reconstructing any inconsistent range by retrieving the range of KV pairs from a non-failed node and sending the range of KV pairs to the recovered node.

Figure 9: Parallel recovery in DEPART.

DEPART parallelizes the read and write processes for recovering multiple ranges of KV pairs for fast recovery. Its parallel recovery process is based on the recovery workflow in Cassandra, as shown in Figure 9. Suppose that we recover the lost data of a failed node at node N0. First, each node in DEPART retrieves the KV pairs from the LSM-tree and the two-layer log, and builds its own Merkle tree (note that the Merkle tree in N0 is initially empty) (Step 1). N0 compares the Merkle trees and identifies the missing KV pairs (Step 2). To recover the lost KV pairs, each surviving node (e.g., node N1 in Figure 9) issues parallel reads to the primary and redundant copies with two threads, and similarly the new node (i.e., N0) retrieves the KV pairs from other surviving nodes and issues parallel writes for the primary and redundant copies with two threads. Such multi-threading is feasible as the primary and redundant copies are stored in different index structures.
sections.translationMarkdown:
为了快速恢复任意故障节点，DEPART 提出了一种并行恢复方案，利用 primary copy 和 redundant copy 存储管理解耦带来的优势。我们首先回顾当前 Cassandra 实现中的恢复过程。Cassandra 当前没有用于监控数据丢失和协调数据恢复的中心化节点。相反，它在每个节点中维护一个 Merkle tree [4, 47]，用于检测多个副本之间的数据不一致。需要注意的是，其他基于 consistent hashing 的分布式 KV store（例如 Dynamo [25] 和 Riak [54]）也使用 Merkle tree。

Merkle tree 是一种二叉 hash tree，其中每个叶节点存储一个 KV pair 范围的 hash 值，而每个非叶节点存储其子节点的 hash 值。如果某个 KV pair 丢失，那么存储这些副本的节点上的 Merkle tree 会检测到该 KV pair 的副本变得不一致，于是 Cassandra 会触发恢复过程。具体而言，恢复过程包含三个步骤：(i) 为每个节点中的每个 KV pair 范围构建 Merkle tree；(ii) 比较不同节点中相同 KV pair 范围的 Merkle tree，以识别不一致的 KV pair 范围（这意味着数据丢失）；(iii) 从未故障节点获取不一致范围的 KV pair，并将该范围的 KV pair 发送到待恢复节点，以重建不一致范围。

图 9：DEPART 中的并行恢复。

DEPART 将恢复多个 KV pair 范围时的读写过程并行化，以实现快速恢复。其并行恢复过程基于 Cassandra 中的恢复工作流，如图 9 所示。假设我们要在节点 N0 恢复某个故障节点丢失的数据。首先，DEPART 中的每个节点从 LSM-tree 和 two-layer log 中取出 KV pair，并构建自己的 Merkle tree（注意，N0 中的 Merkle tree 初始为空）（步骤 1）。N0 比较这些 Merkle tree，并识别缺失的 KV pair（步骤 2）。为了恢复丢失的 KV pair，每个存活节点（例如图 9 中的节点 N1）使用两个线程并行读取 primary copy 和 redundant copy；类似地，新节点（即 N0）从其他存活节点取回 KV pair，并使用两个线程并行写入 primary copy 和 redundant copy。由于 primary copy 和 redundant copy 存储在不同的索引结构中，这种多线程处理是可行的。

sections.title: 5 Evaluation
sections.originalMarkdown:
DEPART builds on the codebase of Cassandra v3.11.4 [2] by implementing replica decoupling in the storage module of each node. Our DEPART prototype itself contains 6.9 K LoC, while the modification to Cassandra contains 1.9 K LoC. Note that Cassandra v3.11.4 contains about 206.2 K LoC.

To demonstrate the benefits of the two-layer log design in DEPART, we also implement the naı̈ve replica decoupling approach that simply stores replicas in multiple LSM-trees, which we refer to as mLSM (§3.2).

We conduct testbed experiments to demonstrate the efficiency of DEPART. We compare our DEPART prototype with Cassandra (v3.11.4), which performs uniform indexing for all replicas, mLSM. We address the following questions.

- How is the overall performance of DEPART compared with Cassandra and mLSM under different settings, e.g., the microbenchmark performance in different types of KV operations, the performance under different consistency configurations and different replication factors, as well as the performance under YCSB core workloads [21, 22]? (Experiments 1-4)
- What are the performance breakdowns of DEPART and Cassandra? (Experiment 5)
- What is the performance of DEPART when a node failure occurs? (Experiments 6-7)
- How does the performance of DEPART vary across parameter settings, including the ordering degree S, the store sizes, and the numbers of storage nodes? (Experiments 8-10)

DEPART 基于 Cassandra v3.11.4 [2] 的代码库，在每个节点的存储模块中实现了副本解耦。DEPART 原型本身包含 6.9 K 行代码，而对 Cassandra 的修改包含 1.9 K 行代码。需要注意的是，Cassandra v3.11.4 约包含 206.2 K 行代码。

为了展示 DEPART 双层日志设计的优势，我们还实现了一种朴素的副本解耦方法：简单地将副本存储在多个 LSM-tree 中，我们称之为 mLSM（§3.2）。

我们开展了测试床实验，以展示 DEPART 的效率。我们将 DEPART 原型与 Cassandra（v3.11.4）和 mLSM 进行比较；Cassandra 对所有副本采用统一索引。我们考察以下问题。

- 在不同设置下，DEPART 的总体性能相比 Cassandra 和 mLSM 如何？例如，不同 KV 操作类型下的微基准性能、不同一致性配置和不同复制因子下的性能，以及 YCSB 核心工作负载下的性能 [21, 22]？（实验 1-4）
- DEPART 和 Cassandra 的性能分解情况如何？（实验 5）
- 节点发生故障时 DEPART 的性能如何？（实验 6-7）
- 在不同参数设置下，包括排序程度 S、存储规模和存储节点数量，DEPART 的性能如何变化？（实验 8-10）

sections.title: 5.1 Setup
sections.originalMarkdown:
**Testbed.** We conduct all experiments on a local cluster of multiple machines, each of which has two 12-core Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2650 v4 @ 2.20 GHz, 32 GiB RAM, and a 500 GiB Samsung 860 EVO SATA SSD. All machines are interconnected via a 10 Gb/s Ethernet switch. Each machine runs CentOS 7.6.1810, with the 64-bit Linux kernel 3.10.0 and the Ext4 file system. We use one machine to simulate multiple clients via a thread pool, while the remaining machines serve as storage nodes.

**Workloads.** We generate workloads with YCSB [21, 22], a general-purpose cloud system benchmark tool. By default, we focus on 1 KiB KV pairs with 24-byte keys, and generate requests based on the Zipf distribution with the default Zipfian constant 0.99. We deploy YCSB on the client machine and set the number of client threads as 50, while each client thread issues a workload from YCSB.

**Default settings.** We configure five storage nodes in the cluster and triple replication to deploy Cassandra and DEPART. Before each experiment, the cluster has empty storage. By default, we set (WCL=1, RCL=1) (i.e., the default setting in Cassandra), which corresponds to eventual consistency. We also study the impact of different consistency levels (Experiments 1 and 2). Both Cassandra and DEPART use the default dynamic snitching module [5] to choose the fastest nodes for serving reads, so as to load-balance reads across different replicas. For the parameter num tokens [2], which determines the number of range groups, we use the default value 256 as in Cassandra.

For DEPART, we set the MemTable size to be the same as that of Cassandra (160 MiB by default), and the segment size in the global log to be the same as the MemTable size. Since DEPART keeps an extra MemTable for the two-layer log, we increase the row cache size of Cassandra by 160 MiB for fair comparisons. For the two-layer log, we set the data size of each split operation as 20 segments (around 3 GiB) and set S as 20 to achieve balanced read and write performance. We keep the other parameter settings in Cassandra unchanged.

We plot the average results over five runs, with error bars showing the standard deviation.

**测试床。** 我们在由多台机器组成的本地集群上开展所有实验。每台机器配备两颗 12 核 Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2650 v4 @ 2.20 GHz、32 GiB 内存和一块 500 GiB Samsung 860 EVO SATA SSD。所有机器通过 10 Gb/s 以太网交换机互连。每台机器运行 CentOS 7.6.1810，使用 64 位 Linux 内核 3.10.0 和 Ext4 文件系统。我们使用一台机器通过线程池模拟多个客户端，其余机器作为存储节点。

**工作负载。** 我们使用 YCSB [21, 22]（一种通用云系统基准测试工具）生成工作负载。默认情况下，我们关注键长为 24 字节、大小为 1 KiB 的 KV 对，并使用默认 Zipf 常数 0.99 的 Zipf 分布生成请求。我们在客户端机器上部署 YCSB，并将客户端线程数设置为 50；每个客户端线程从 YCSB 发出一个工作负载。

**默认设置。** 我们在集群中配置 5 个存储节点，并采用三副本部署 Cassandra 和 DEPART。每个实验开始前，集群存储均为空。默认情况下，我们设置 (WCL=1, RCL=1)（即 Cassandra 的默认设置），这对应最终一致性。我们还研究不同一致性级别的影响（实验 1 和 2）。Cassandra 和 DEPART 都使用默认的 dynamic snitching 模块 [5] 选择最快的节点提供读服务，从而在不同副本之间实现读负载均衡。对于决定 range group 数量的参数 num tokens [2]，我们采用 Cassandra 中的默认值 256。

对于 DEPART，我们将 MemTable 大小设置为与 Cassandra 相同（默认为 160 MiB），并将 global log 中 segment 的大小设置为与 MemTable 大小相同。由于 DEPART 为双层日志额外维护一个 MemTable，为了进行公平比较，我们将 Cassandra 的 row cache 大小增加 160 MiB。对于双层日志，我们将每次 split 操作的数据量设置为 20 个 segment（约 3 GiB），并将 S 设置为 20，以平衡读写性能。Cassandra 中的其他参数设置保持不变。

我们绘制 5 次运行的平均结果，误差条表示标准差。
