sections.title: Experiment 1 (Performance in KV operations)
sections.originalMarkdown:
We first compare the performance of Cassandra, mLSM, and DEPART in different KV operations, including writes (i.e., writing new KV pairs), reads (i.e., reading existing KV pairs), scans (i.e., reading existing consecutive KV pairs), and updates (i.e., updating existing KV pairs). We configure the client machine to first randomly write 200 M KV pairs. It then issues the following requests in order: (i) 20 M reads, (ii) 2 M scans (each scan contains one seek() to locate the first key and then iterates with 100 next()’s), and (iii) 200 M updates. We also consider two settings of consistency levels: (i) (WCL=3, RCL=1) (i.e., strong consistency) and (ii) (WCL=1, RCL=1) (i.e., eventual consistency).

*Figure 10: Exp#1 (Performance in KV operations).*

Figure 10 shows the throughput and latency results. First, DEPART improves the overall performance over Cassandra in all cases. For (WCL=3, RCL=1), DEPART increases the throughput of writes, reads, scans, and updates to 1.42×, 2.29×, 2.22×, and 1.45×, respectively; it reduces the average write latency, average read latency, 99-th percentile write latency, and 99-th percentile read latency by 29%, 58%, 39%, and 41%, respectively. For (WCL=1, RCL=1), DEPART improves the throughput of writes, reads, scans, and updates to 1.43×, 2.43×, 2.68×, and 1.44×, respectively; it reduces the average write latency, average read latency, 99-th percentile write latency, and 99-th percentile read latency by 30%, 59%, 41%, and 48%, respectively. The latency results for scans and updates are similar and we omit the results here. The main reasons of the performance improvements of DEPART are two-fold. First, for reads, DEPART only searches the LSM-tree or the specific range group in the two-layer log within a node, thereby greatly reducing the search space. Second, for writes, DEPART mitigates the compaction overhead in the LSM-tree, which now keeps the primary copies only. The two-layer log also has limited merge-sort overhead by having a large value of the ordering degree S.

Second, mLSM notably improves the read performance, but only shows marginal improvements on writes. Specifically, compared with Cassandra, it increases the throughput of writes, reads, scans, and updates by 1.18-1.20×, 2.11-2.20×, 1.85-2.0×, and 1.15-1.20×, respectively. It also reduces the average write latency, average read latency, 99-th percentile write latency, and 99-th percentile read latency by 15-17%, 53-56%, 16-18%, and 34-41%, respectively. The reason is that mLSM still triggers frequent compaction operations, which compete for disk bandwidth and degrade the write performance. For example, the total compaction sizes of Cassandra and mLSM are 3.46 TiB and 2.72 TiB, respectively, and the total compaction and merge-sort size of DEPART is 1.65 TiB (i.e., compared with Cassandra, mLSM only reduces the total compaction size by 21%, but DEPART reduces it by 52%).

We next compare the storage and memory costs of Cassandra, mLSM, and DEPART. After the end of the update phase, the KV store sizes are 613.5 GiB for Cassandra, 611.3 GiB for mLSM, and 654.8 GiB for DEPART. DEPART incurs 6.7% additional storage overhead compared with Cassandra, since each range group allows at most S = 20 sorted runs in our default setting and contains invalid KV pairs before being merge-sorted. To measure the memory overhead, we note that the MemTable size varies over time (up to the 160 MiB limit) as the KV pairs are continuously inserted into a MemTable and flushed to disk when the MemTable is full. Thus, we measure the total memory usage of the MemTables every five seconds and obtain the average results. The total memory usage of mLSM is 335.7 MiB, which is 3.7× that of Cassandra (90.4 MiB), as each LSM-tree maintains a MemTable. However, DEPART only costs 183.9 MiB, which is 2.0× that of Cassandra, since DEPART only maintains one extra MemTable for the two-layer log. Note that the total memory usage of mLSM increases with the replication factor, while that of DEPART remains unaffected.

*Figure 11: Exp#1 (Read and write amplifications).*

Finally, we compare the read/write amplifications (i.e., the ratios between the amounts of system reads/writes and the amounts of the user reads/writes) of Cassandra, mLSM, and DEPART. Figure 11 shows the results. Compared with Cassandra, mLSM reduces the read and write amplifications by up to 40% and 24%, respectively, while DEPART reduces the read and write amplifications by up to 53% and 52%, respectively. Note that the performance gain of DEPART is similar under both consistency levels, so we focus on (WCL=1, RCL=1) in the following experiments (except Exp#2 and 8).
sections.translationMarkdown:
我们首先比较 Cassandra、mLSM 和 DEPART 在不同 KV 操作下的性能，包括写入（即写入新的 KV 对）、读取（即读取已有的 KV 对）、扫描（即读取已有的连续 KV 对）和更新（即更新已有的 KV 对）。我们配置客户端机器先随机写入 200 M 个 KV 对，然后按以下顺序发出请求：(i) 20 M 次读取；(ii) 2 M 次扫描（每次扫描包含一次用于定位第一个 key 的 seek()，随后迭代执行 100 次 next()）；以及 (iii) 200 M 次更新。我们还考虑两种一致性级别设置：(i) (WCL=3, RCL=1)（即强一致性）；以及 (ii) (WCL=1, RCL=1)（即最终一致性）。

*图 10：实验 1（KV 操作性能）。*

图 10 展示了吞吐量和延迟结果。首先，在所有情况下，DEPART 的总体性能都优于 Cassandra。对于 (WCL=3, RCL=1)，DEPART 将写入、读取、扫描和更新的吞吐量分别提升至 1.42×、2.29×、2.22× 和 1.45×；将平均写入延迟、平均读取延迟、第 99 百分位写入延迟和第 99 百分位读取延迟分别降低 29%、58%、39% 和 41%。对于 (WCL=1, RCL=1)，DEPART 将写入、读取、扫描和更新的吞吐量分别提升至 1.43×、2.43×、2.68× 和 1.44×；将平均写入延迟、平均读取延迟、第 99 百分位写入延迟和第 99 百分位读取延迟分别降低 30%、59%、41% 和 48%。扫描和更新的延迟结果相近，因此这里省略。DEPART 性能提升的主要原因有两个。第一，对于读取，DEPART 在节点内只搜索 LSM-tree 或双层日志中的特定 range group，从而大幅缩小搜索空间。第二，对于写入，DEPART 减轻了 LSM-tree 的 compaction 开销，因为 LSM-tree 现在只保存 primary copies。通过采用较大的排序程度 S，双层日志的 merge-sort 开销也受到限制。

其次，mLSM 显著改善了读取性能，但写入性能提升有限。具体而言，与 Cassandra 相比，其写入、读取、扫描和更新吞吐量分别提升 1.18-1.20×、2.11-2.20×、1.85-2.0× 和 1.15-1.20×；平均写入延迟、平均读取延迟、第 99 百分位写入延迟和第 99 百分位读取延迟分别降低 15-17%、53-56%、16-18% 和 34-41%。原因在于 mLSM 仍会频繁触发 compaction 操作，这些操作会争用磁盘带宽并降低写入性能。例如，Cassandra 和 mLSM 的 compaction 总规模分别为 3.46 TiB 和 2.72 TiB，而 DEPART 的 compaction 与 merge-sort 总规模为 1.65 TiB（也就是说，相比 Cassandra，mLSM 仅将 compaction 总规模降低了 21%，而 DEPART 降低了 52%）。

接下来，我们比较 Cassandra、mLSM 和 DEPART 的存储与内存开销。更新阶段结束后，Cassandra、mLSM 和 DEPART 的 KV 存储规模分别为 613.5 GiB、611.3 GiB 和 654.8 GiB。DEPART 相比 Cassandra 产生了 6.7% 的额外存储开销，这是因为在默认设置下，每个 range group 最多允许 S = 20 个 sorted run，并且在 merge-sort 之前会包含无效 KV 对。为了测量内存开销，需要注意的是，随着 KV 对持续插入 MemTable，并在 MemTable 满时刷新到磁盘，MemTable 大小会随时间变化（上限为 160 MiB）。因此，我们每 5 秒测量一次 MemTable 的总内存使用量，并计算平均值。mLSM 的总内存使用量为 335.7 MiB，是 Cassandra（90.4 MiB）的 3.7 倍，因为每个 LSM-tree 都维护一个 MemTable。然而，DEPART 只需 183.9 MiB，是 Cassandra 的 2.0 倍，因为 DEPART 仅为双层日志额外维护一个 MemTable。注意，mLSM 的总内存使用量会随复制因子增加，而 DEPART 的总内存使用量不受影响。

*图 11：实验 1（读写放大）。*

最后，我们比较 Cassandra、mLSM 和 DEPART 的读/写放大（即系统读/写量与用户读/写量的比值）。图 11 展示了结果。与 Cassandra 相比，mLSM 将读放大和写放大最多分别降低 40% 和 24%，而 DEPART 将读放大和写放大最多分别降低 53% 和 52%。注意，在两种一致性级别下，DEPART 的性能收益相近，因此在后续实验中我们聚焦于 (WCL=1, RCL=1)（实验 2 和 8 除外）。

sections.title: Experiment 2 (Performance under different consistency configurations)
sections.titleTranslation: 实验 2（不同一致性配置下的性能）
sections.originalMarkdown:
We evaluate the performance under different consistency configurations. In particular, for strong consistency, we consider additional configurations for WCL and RCL under triple replication that satisfy the condition WCL+RCL>3, including (WCL=2, RCL=2) and (WCL=1, RCL=3).

*Figure 12: Exp#2 (Performance under different consistency configurations).*

Figure 12 shows the results. DEPART consistently improves the throughput of writes, reads, scans, and updates over Cassandra under different consistency configurations. Specifically, for (WCL=2, RCL=2), DEPART increases the throughput of writes, reads, scans, and updates to 1.43×, 1.70×, 1.38×, and 1.44×, respectively. For (WCL=1, RCL=3), DEPART increases the throughput of writes, reads, scans, and updates to 1.44×, 1.72×, 1.62×, 1.45×, respectively. DEPART also consistently improves the throughput of writes and updates over mLSM. Note that the write performance gains of DEPART over Cassandra stay nearly the same under different consistency configurations, since the index structures of both Cassandra and DEPART remain unchanged under triple replication.

However, the read performance gains of DEPART over Cassandra become smaller, and DEPART’s read performance is worse than mLSM for RCL≥2. In this case, each read request needs to access at least two replicas successfully, so the redundant copies in the two-layer log must be searched. As the redundant copies in the two-layer log are not fully sorted, the performance is slower than reading the primary copies in the LSM-tree. Nevertheless, DEPART still achieves faster reads than Cassandra, as it searches for less data than Cassandra. Also, mLSM keeps redundant copies being fully sorted in each level, so it achieves higher read performance than DEPART. On the other hand, for RCL=1, each read only needs to access one replica for a successful operation. Most of the reads are routed to their primary copies, whose read latency is smaller than that of the redundant copies as determined by the dynamic snitching module (§2.2). Thus, the read performance gains under RCL=1 are higher than those under RCL≥2 in general.
sections.translationMarkdown:
我们评估不同一致性配置下的性能。具体而言，对于强一致性，在三副本场景下，我们考虑满足 WCL+RCL>3 条件的其他 WCL 和 RCL 配置，包括 (WCL=2, RCL=2) 和 (WCL=1, RCL=3)。

*图 12：实验 2（不同一致性配置下的性能）。*

图 12 展示了结果。在不同一致性配置下，DEPART 都持续提升了相对于 Cassandra 的写入、读取、扫描和更新吞吐量。具体而言，对于 (WCL=2, RCL=2)，DEPART 将写入、读取、扫描和更新吞吐量分别提升至 1.43×、1.70×、1.38× 和 1.44×。对于 (WCL=1, RCL=3)，DEPART 将写入、读取、扫描和更新吞吐量分别提升至 1.44×、1.72×、1.62× 和 1.45×。相对于 mLSM，DEPART 也持续提升了写入和更新吞吐量。注意，DEPART 相对于 Cassandra 的写入性能收益在不同一致性配置下几乎保持不变，因为在三副本场景下，Cassandra 和 DEPART 的索引结构都不发生变化。

然而，DEPART 相对于 Cassandra 的读取性能收益会变小，并且当 RCL≥2 时，DEPART 的读取性能不如 mLSM。在这种情况下，每个读取请求都需要成功访问至少两个副本，因此必须搜索双层日志中的 redundant copies。由于双层日志中的 redundant copies 并未完全排序，其读取性能慢于 LSM-tree 中 primary copies 的读取性能。尽管如此，DEPART 的读取速度仍然快于 Cassandra，因为它搜索的数据量少于 Cassandra。此外，mLSM 在每个 level 中都保持 redundant copies 完全有序，因此其读取性能高于 DEPART。另一方面，当 RCL=1 时，每次读取只需访问一个副本即可成功完成。大多数读取会被路由到 primary copies；dynamic snitching 模块（§2.2）确定这些副本的读取延迟小于 redundant copies。因此，通常 RCL=1 下的读取性能收益高于 RCL≥2 下的收益。

sections.title: Experiment 3 (Performance under different replication factors)
sections.titleTranslation: 实验 3（不同复制因子下的性能）
sections.originalMarkdown:
We evaluate the performance of DEPART by varying the replication factor k from 3 to 5. We configure the client machine to first randomly write 200 M KV pairs and then issue 20 M reads.

*Figure 13: Exp#3 (Performance under different replication factors).*

Figure 13 shows the throughput results of writes and reads versus the replication factor. Compared with Cassandra, DEPART increases the throughput of writes and reads to 1.43-1.59× and 2.43-3.61×, respectively. Also, DEPART achieves a higher throughput gain for a larger replication factor. The main reasons are two-fold. First, for reads, DEPART either reads primary copies from the LSM-tree or reads redundant copies from the two-layer log; for the latter, it only searches the global log and the corresponding range group in the two-layer log. Thus, the read performance of DEPART is less affected by the number of replicas. However, Cassandra stores all replicas in a single LSM-tree and its reads need to traverse the whole LSM-tree. Its read performance drops significantly as the replication factor increases. Second, for writes, DEPART implements replica decoupling and manages the redundant copies in range groups. When the number of replicas increases, the compaction cost in the LSM-tree remains unchanged and the merge-sort cost in the two-layer log increases only slightly. However, Cassandra stores all replicas in the single LSM-tree and the compaction cost increases significantly as the number of replicas increases. Combining both reasons, the performance gain of DEPART becomes larger for a higher replication factor.

Similar to DEPART, mLSM also consistently improves the throughput of writes and reads over Cassandra under different replication factors. When the replication factor increases to k = 4 and k = 5, its read performance is even better than DEPART. The main reason is that mLSM only searches the corresponding LSM-tree that is fully sorted in each level regardless of the replication factor, but DEPART keeps redundant copies in the two-layer log that is not fully sorted under the default setting. Note that we can tune the degree of ordering of the two-layer log to further increase the read performance. Furthermore, the memory usage of DEPART remains 2× that of Cassandra, but that of mLSM increases to 5× when the replication factor increases to k = 5.
sections.translationMarkdown:
我们通过将复制因子 k 从 3 变为 5 来评估 DEPART 的性能。我们配置客户端机器先随机写入 200 M 个 KV 对，然后发出 20 M 次读取请求。

*图 13：实验 3（不同复制因子下的性能）。*

图 13 展示了不同复制因子下的写入和读取吞吐量结果。与 Cassandra 相比，DEPART 将写入和读取吞吐量分别提升至 1.43-1.59× 和 2.43-3.61×。此外，复制因子越大，DEPART 获得的吞吐量收益越高。主要原因有两个。第一，对于读取，DEPART 要么从 LSM-tree 读取 primary copies，要么从双层日志读取 redundant copies；对于后者，它只需搜索 global log 和双层日志中对应的 range group。因此，副本数量对 DEPART 读取性能的影响较小。然而，Cassandra 将所有副本存储在同一个 LSM-tree 中，读取时需要遍历整个 LSM-tree。随着复制因子增加，其读取性能显著下降。第二，对于写入，DEPART 实现副本解耦，并在 range group 中管理 redundant copies。当副本数量增加时，LSM-tree 中的 compaction 成本保持不变，而双层日志中的 merge-sort 成本只略微增加。然而，Cassandra 将所有副本存储在同一个 LSM-tree 中，随着副本数量增加，compaction 成本显著增加。综合这两个原因，复制因子越高，DEPART 的性能收益越大。

与 DEPART 类似，在不同复制因子下，mLSM 相对于 Cassandra 也持续提升了写入和读取吞吐量。当复制因子增加到 k = 4 和 k = 5 时，mLSM 的读取性能甚至优于 DEPART。主要原因是，无论复制因子如何变化，mLSM 只搜索对应的 LSM-tree，并且该 LSM-tree 在每个 level 中都是完全有序的；而在默认设置下，DEPART 将 redundant copies 保存在并非完全有序的双层日志中。注意，我们可以调节双层日志的排序程度，进一步提升读取性能。此外，DEPART 的内存使用量保持为 Cassandra 的 2 倍，而当复制因子增加到 k = 5 时，mLSM 的内存使用量增加到 Cassandra 的 5 倍。

sections.title: Experiment 4 (YCSB performance)
sections.originalMarkdown:
We compare Cassandra, mLSM, and DEPART using the six YCSB core workloads [21, 22], namely A (50% reads, 50% writes), B (95% reads, 5% writes), C (100% reads), D (95% reads, 5% writes), E (95% scans, 5% writes), and F (50% reads, 50% read-modify-writes). The client machine first randomly writes 200 M KV pairs to the cluster before running each of the six YCSB core workloads. Each workload consists of 100 M operations, except for Workload E, which contains 10 M operations with each scan involving 100 next()’s.

*Figure 14: Exp#4 (YCSB performance).*

Figure 14 shows the results. DEPART outperforms Cassandra under all workloads. Specifically, it increases the throughput to 1.4-2.1× under read-dominant Workloads B-D, 1.6-2.2× under write-dominant Workloads A and F, and 2.4× under scan-dominant Workload E. With replica decoupling and the two-layer log design, DEPART reduces the compaction overhead of the LSM-tree during writes and reduces the search space during reads, so it improves both read and write performance simultaneously. On the other hand, mLSM also outperforms Cassandra under all workloads due to replica decoupling. However, DEPART further improves the performance of mLSM, as the latter incurs large compaction overhead.
sections.translationMarkdown:
我们使用 YCSB 的六个核心工作负载 [21, 22] 比较 Cassandra、mLSM 和 DEPART，具体为 A（50% 读取、50% 写入）、B（95% 读取、5% 写入）、C（100% 读取）、D（95% 读取、5% 写入）、E（95% 扫描、5% 写入）和 F（50% 读取、50% 读-修改-写）。在运行六个 YCSB 核心工作负载中的每一个之前，客户端机器先向集群随机写入 200 M 个 KV 对。每个工作负载包含 100 M 次操作，但工作负载 E 例外：它包含 10 M 次操作，每次扫描涉及 100 次 next()。

*图 14：实验 4（YCSB 性能）。*

图 14 展示了结果。在所有工作负载下，DEPART 的性能都优于 Cassandra。具体而言，在以读为主的工作负载 B-D 下，吞吐量提升 1.4-2.1×；在以写为主的工作负载 A 和 F 下，吞吐量提升 1.6-2.2×；在以扫描为主的工作负载 E 下，吞吐量提升 2.4×。借助副本解耦和双层日志设计，DEPART 降低了写入期间 LSM-tree 的 compaction 开销，并缩小了读取期间的搜索空间，因此能够同时改善读写性能。另一方面，由于副本解耦，mLSM 在所有工作负载下也优于 Cassandra。不过，DEPART 进一步提升了 mLSM 的性能，因为后者会产生较大的 compaction 开销。

sections.title: Experiment 5 (Time breakdown for reads/writes)
sections.originalMarkdown:
We show the time breakdown for both read and write processes in Cassandra and DEPART. We configure the client machine to first load 200 M KV pairs, followed by issuing 20 M reads. The read process comprises the reads to the MemTable, the cache (including the row cache and key cache), the index block of an SSTable (e.g., the Bloom filters and offsets), and the data block in the SSTable. Note that each segment in the two-layer log is treated as an SSTable here. The write process comprises writes to the WAL, writes to the MemTable, flushing the MemTable, the compaction of the LSM-tree, and the merge-sorts of the two-layer log (in DEPART only).

*Figure 15: Exp#5 (Time breakdown for reads/writes).*

Figure 15 shows the time breakdown for reads and writes. For reads, most of the read time is for reading the index blocks of SSTables in both Cassandra and DEPART, since reading a KV pair needs to check the Bloom filter in the index block in each LSM-tree level to determine if the KV pair exists, and reads the data block from the SSTable according to the offset in the index block only if it does. Overall, DEPART reduces the time costs of reading the index blocks and the data blocks of SSTables by 56% and 45%, respectively. The reasons are two-fold. First, DEPART stores only the primary copies in the LSM-tree, so the number of SSTables in the LSM-tree greatly decreases. Also, DEPART manages the redundant copies in range groups, so the number of reads for locating a KV pair decreases as well.

For writes, DEPART reduces the time costs of writes to the WAL and writes to the MemTable by 28% and 37%, respectively, as DEPART writes primary and redundant copies in parallel. DEPART also greatly reduces the compaction overhead by reducing the LSM-tree size; for example, its compaction time is only 30.7% of Cassandra’s. Furthermore, the merge-sort time of the two-layer log in DEPART is only 21.4% of the compaction time in Cassandra. Thus, the total time of compaction and merge-sorts in DEPART is only 52.1% of the compaction time in Cassandra.
sections.translationMarkdown:
我们展示 Cassandra 和 DEPART 中读写过程的时间分解。我们配置客户端机器先加载 200 M 个 KV 对，然后发出 20 M 次读取请求。读取过程包括读取 MemTable、cache（包括 row cache 和 key cache）、SSTable 的 index block（例如 Bloom filter 和 offset）以及 SSTable 中的 data block。注意，这里将双层日志中的每个 segment 视为一个 SSTable。写入过程包括写入 WAL、写入 MemTable、刷新 MemTable、LSM-tree 的 compaction，以及双层日志的 merge-sort（仅 DEPART 有）。

*图 15：实验 5（读写时间分解）。*

图 15 展示了读写的时间分解。对于读取，在 Cassandra 和 DEPART 中，大部分读取时间都用于读取 SSTable 的 index block。这是因为读取一个 KV 对时，需要检查每个 LSM-tree level 的 index block 中的 Bloom filter，以确定 KV 对是否存在；只有在确定存在时，才会根据 index block 中的 offset 从 SSTable 读取 data block。总体而言，DEPART 将读取 SSTable index block 和 data block 的时间开销分别降低了 56% 和 45%。原因有两个。第一，DEPART 在 LSM-tree 中只存储 primary copies，因此 LSM-tree 中的 SSTable 数量大幅减少。此外，DEPART 在 range group 中管理 redundant copies，因此定位 KV 对所需的读取次数也会减少。

对于写入，由于 DEPART 并行写入 primary copies 和 redundant copies，它将写入 WAL 和写入 MemTable 的时间开销分别降低了 28% 和 37%。DEPART 还通过缩小 LSM-tree 的规模大幅降低 compaction 开销；例如，其 compaction 时间仅为 Cassandra 的 30.7%。此外，DEPART 双层日志的 merge-sort 时间仅为 Cassandra compaction 时间的 21.4%。因此，DEPART 中 compaction 与 merge-sort 的总时间仅为 Cassandra compaction 时间的 52.1%。

sections.title: Experiment 6 (Recovery performance)
sections.originalMarkdown:
We evaluate the recovery performance on recovering a failed node. We consider different write sizes, by configuring the client machine to randomly write 20 M, 50 M, and 100 M KV pairs to the cluster. We then crash one node, by killing the KV store process with the “kill -s processID” command and removing all its data with the “rm -r data” command. Finally, we restart the KV store process on the same node and call the “nodetool repair -full keyspacename” command for recovery.

*Figure 16: Exp#6 (Recovery performance).*

Figure 16(a) shows the total recovery time. Cassandra takes 8.9, 26.9, and 72.4 minutes to recover 20 M, 50 M, and 100 M KV pairs, respectively, while DEPART only takes 4.1, 15.4, and 45.2 minutes, respectively. Overall, DEPART reduces the recovery time of Cassandra by 38-54%. The main reason is that DEPART repairs primary and redundant copies in parallel, and scans much less data during recovery due to replica decoupling.

Figure 16(b) also shows the breakdown results of the recovery time for repairing 50 M and 100 M KV pairs. We consider different steps: Build MTs (i.e., building Merkle trees for all nodes), Compare MTs (i.e., comparing all Merkle trees), Receive&Write (i.e., receiving repaired data from other nodes and writing data to disk), and Others (i.e., other operations in recovery). DEPART reduces the time costs of Build MTs and Receive&Write by nearly a half compared to Cassandra through parallelizing the read/write processes to the primary and redundant copies.
sections.translationMarkdown:
我们评估恢复故障节点时的恢复性能。我们设置不同的写入规模：配置客户端机器向集群随机写入 20 M、50 M 和 100 M 个 KV 对。随后，我们使用“kill -s processID”命令终止 KV 存储进程，并使用“rm -r data”命令删除其全部数据，从而使一个节点崩溃。最后，我们在同一节点上重启 KV 存储进程，并调用“nodetool repair -full keyspacename”命令执行恢复。

*图 16：实验 6（恢复性能）。*

图 16(a) 展示了总恢复时间。Cassandra 恢复 20 M、50 M 和 100 M 个 KV 对分别需要 8.9、26.9 和 72.4 分钟，而 DEPART 分别只需 4.1、15.4 和 45.2 分钟。总体而言，DEPART 将 Cassandra 的恢复时间降低了 38-54%。主要原因是 DEPART 并行修复 primary copies 和 redundant copies，并且由于副本解耦，在恢复过程中扫描的数据量少得多。

图 16(b) 还展示了修复 50 M 和 100 M 个 KV 对时的恢复时间分解结果。我们考虑以下不同步骤：Build MTs（即为所有节点构建 Merkle tree）、Compare MTs（即比较所有 Merkle tree）、Receive&Write（即从其他节点接收修复数据并将数据写入磁盘）以及 Others（即恢复过程中的其他操作）。通过并行执行针对 primary copies 和 redundant copies 的读写过程，DEPART 将 Build MTs 和 Receive&Write 的时间开销相比 Cassandra 几乎降低了一半。

sections.title: Experiment 7 (Performance when a node crashes)
sections.titleTranslation: 实验 7（节点崩溃时的性能）
sections.originalMarkdown:
We evaluate the read, write and update performance when a node crashes and before it is repaired. The client machine first randomly writes 100 M KV pairs to the cluster and we manually crash one node as in Experiment 6. We then issue 20 M reads, 100 M writes, and 100 M updates.

*Figure 17: Exp#7 (Performance when a node crashes).*

Figure 17(a) shows the throughput under a node failure. Compared with Cassandra, DEPART increases the throughput of reads, writes, and updates to 1.69×, 1.59×, and 1.55×, respectively. The main reason is that DEPART always searches much less data than Cassandra, even though it reads the redundant copies from the two-layer log. Also, DEPART always improves write performance under both normal and failure modes.

We also evaluate the degraded read performance in different cases: (i) the node repair is not yet triggered, (ii) the node repair is in progress, and (iii) the two-layer log for redundant copies in each node supports a higher degree of ordering by decreasing the threshold S (§4.4) from the default value 20 to 5. Figure 17(b) shows the degraded read throughput. When node repair is not triggered or is in progress, DEPART improves the throughput of degraded reads to 1.69× and 1.75×, respectively, since DEPART always searches much less data compared to uniform indexing in Cassandra. Also, when the two-layer log has a higher degree of ordering (e.g., with a smaller threshold S), the degraded read performance gains of DEPART become larger, because it is more efficient to read the KV pairs in the two-layer log that with a high degree of ordering.
sections.translationMarkdown:
我们评估节点崩溃且尚未修复时的读取、写入和更新性能。客户端机器先向集群随机写入 100 M 个 KV 对，然后按照实验 6 的方式手动使一个节点崩溃。接着发出 20 M 次读取、100 M 次写入和 100 M 次更新请求。

*图 17：实验 7（节点崩溃时的性能）。*

图 17(a) 展示了节点故障下的吞吐量。与 Cassandra 相比，DEPART 将读取、写入和更新吞吐量分别提升至 1.69×、1.59× 和 1.55×。主要原因是，即使从双层日志读取 redundant copies，DEPART 始终搜索远少于 Cassandra 的数据。此外，无论正常模式还是故障模式，DEPART 都能改善写入性能。

我们还评估了以下不同情况下的降级读取性能：(i) 尚未触发节点修复；(ii) 节点修复正在进行；以及 (iii) 将默认值 20 的阈值 S（§4.4）降低到 5，使每个节点中用于保存 redundant copies 的双层日志支持更高的排序程度。图 17(b) 展示了降级读取吞吐量。当尚未触发节点修复或节点修复正在进行时，DEPART 的降级读取吞吐量分别提升至 1.69× 和 1.75×，因为相比 Cassandra 的统一索引，DEPART 始终搜索少得多的数据。此外，当双层日志具有更高的排序程度时（例如使用更小的阈值 S），DEPART 的降级读取性能收益会变大，因为在排序程度高的双层日志中读取 KV 对更加高效。

sections.title: Experiment 8 (Impact of the ordering degree S)
sections.titleTranslation: 实验 8（排序程度 S 的影响）
sections.originalMarkdown:
We evaluate the write and read performance under different settings of the ordering degree S in DEPART, so as to show how DEPART can balance the write and read performance gains for the redundant copies by tuning the value of S. The client machine first randomly writes 200 M KV pairs to the cluster, followed by issuing 20 M reads. Here, we use the consistency configuration (WCL=2, RCL=2), so that the redundant copies must be accessed for each successful read.

**Table 1: Exp#8 (Impact of the ordering degree S).**

| S | Write thpt (KOPS) | Read thpt (KOPS) |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 37.2 | 42.3 |
| 10 | 57.2 | 31.5 |
| 20 | 64.7 | 23.1 |
| → ∞ | 78.4 | 7.6 |
| Cassandra | 45.4 | 15.4 |

Table 1 shows the results. For DEPART, if S = 1, the two-layer log reduces to a two-level LSM-tree, so it achieves the highest read throughput as the KV pairs are fully sorted, but the write throughput is the least due to the frequent merge-sorts for maintaining a single sorted run in each range group in the local logs. As we increase S (e.g., S is 10 or 20), the ordering of the two-layer log is relaxed and hence the merge-sort overhead becomes smaller, so the write throughput increases. As we set S to be a sufficiently large value, the two-layer log reduces to the append-only log, so the write throughput is the highest, but the read throughput is the least. Note that when S is 1, 10, or 20, DEPART still maintains higher throughput in both writes and reads than Cassandra, even though there exists a performance trade-off between writes and reads in DEPART.
sections.translationMarkdown:
我们评估 DEPART 在不同排序程度 S 设置下的写入和读取性能，以展示 DEPART 如何通过调节 S 的值，在 redundant copies 的读写性能收益之间取得平衡。客户端机器先向集群随机写入 200 M 个 KV 对，然后发出 20 M 次读取请求。这里使用一致性配置 (WCL=2, RCL=2)，因此每次成功读取都必须访问 redundant copies。

**表 1：实验 8（排序程度 S 的影响）。**

| S | 写入吞吐量（KOPS） | 读取吞吐量（KOPS） |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 37.2 | 42.3 |
| 10 | 57.2 | 31.5 |
| 20 | 64.7 | 23.1 |
| → ∞ | 78.4 | 7.6 |
| Cassandra | 45.4 | 15.4 |

表 1 展示了结果。对于 DEPART，当 S = 1 时，双层日志退化为两级 LSM-tree。由于 KV 对完全有序，它获得最高的读取吞吐量；但为了在 local logs 的每个 range group 中维持单个 sorted run，需要频繁执行 merge-sort，因此写入吞吐量最低。随着我们增大 S（例如 S 为 10 或 20），双层日志的有序性降低，merge-sort 开销随之减小，因此写入吞吐量提高。当我们将 S 设置为足够大的值时，双层日志退化为 append-only log，因此写入吞吐量最高，但读取吞吐量最低。注意，当 S 为 1、10 或 20 时，尽管 DEPART 的读写之间存在性能权衡，其写入和读取吞吐量仍都高于 Cassandra。

sections.title: Experiment 9 (Impact of different KV store sizes)
sections.titleTranslation: 实验 9（不同 KV 存储规模的影响）
sections.originalMarkdown:
We now evaluate the impact of different KV store sizes. We vary the data size written by the client from 200 M to 400 M KV pairs (i.e., the total amount of primary and redundant copies increases from 600 GiB to 1200 GiB under triple replication).

*Figure 18: Exp#9 (Impact of different KV store sizes).*

Figure 18 shows the throughput of writes and reads under different KV store sizes. Compared with Cassandra, DEPART improves the write and read throughput by 1.43-1.52× and 2.43-2.95×, respectively. Also, the performance gains of DEPART increase as the KV store size increases, as DEPART alleviates the write and read amplifications via replica decoupling, but Cassandra aggravates the write and read amplifications via uniform indexing.

To better show the scalability of the two-layer log design under different KV store sizes, we also evaluate the compaction time of the LSM-tree and the merge-sort time of the two-layer log in DEPART, and compare them with the compaction time in Cassandra. When the KV store size increases from 200 M to 400 M KV pairs, the compaction time in Cassandra increases 2.3×, while the total time of compaction and merge-sort operations in DEPART only increases 1.9×. In particular, the ratio of the merge-sort time in DEPART to the compaction time in Cassandra drops from 21.4% to 18.7%, and the ratio of the compaction time in DEPART to the compaction time in Cassandra drops from 30.7% to 25.2%. Thus, DEPART scales well as the KV store grows.
sections.translationMarkdown:
现在我们评估不同 KV 存储规模的影响。我们将客户端写入的数据量从 200 M 变为 400 M 个 KV 对（即在三副本场景下，primary copies 和 redundant copies 的总量从 600 GiB 增加到 1200 GiB）。

*图 18：实验 9（不同 KV 存储规模的影响）。*

图 18 展示了不同 KV 存储规模下的写入和读取吞吐量。与 Cassandra 相比，DEPART 将写入和读取吞吐量分别提升 1.43-1.52× 和 2.43-2.95×。此外，随着 KV 存储规模增大，DEPART 的性能收益也会增加：DEPART 通过副本解耦减轻了读写放大，而 Cassandra 通过统一索引加剧了读写放大。

为了更好地展示双层日志设计在不同 KV 存储规模下的可扩展性，我们还评估 DEPART 中 LSM-tree 的 compaction 时间和双层日志的 merge-sort 时间，并将其与 Cassandra 中的 compaction 时间进行比较。当 KV 存储规模从 200 M 增加到 400 M 个 KV 对时，Cassandra 的 compaction 时间增加了 2.3 倍，而 DEPART 中 compaction 与 merge-sort 操作的总时间仅增加 1.9 倍。具体而言，DEPART 的 merge-sort 时间与 Cassandra compaction 时间之比从 21.4% 降至 18.7%，DEPART 的 compaction 时间与 Cassandra compaction 时间之比从 30.7% 降至 25.2%。因此，随着 KV 存储规模增长，DEPART 具有良好的可扩展性。

sections.title: Experiment 10 (Impact of different numbers of nodes)
sections.titleTranslation: 实验 10（不同节点数量的影响）
sections.originalMarkdown:
We evaluate the performance of DEPART when the cluster contains more nodes. We vary the number of nodes as 5, 8, and 10. We configure the client machine to issue the writes of 200 M, 320 M, and 400 M KV pairs, respectively, so that each node contains the same amount of data. After the writes, we configure the client machine to issue 20 M, 32 M, and 40 M reads, respectively.

*Figure 19: Exp#10 (Impact of different numbers of nodes).*

Figure 19 shows the throughput results of write and read operations. Compared with Cassandra, DEPART increases the throughput of writes and reads to 1.35-1.43× and 2.26-2.43×, respectively. DEPART maintains its performance gains over Cassandra via replica decoupling, regardless of the cluster size. Thus, DEPART achieves good scalability as the cluster size increases.
sections.translationMarkdown:
我们评估集群包含更多节点时 DEPART 的性能。我们将节点数量设为 5、8 和 10。我们配置客户端机器分别写入 200 M、320 M 和 400 M 个 KV 对，使每个节点包含相同数量的数据。完成写入后，我们配置客户端机器分别发出 20 M、32 M 和 40 M 次读取请求。

*图 19：实验 10（不同节点数量的影响）。*

图 19 展示了写入和读取操作的吞吐量结果。与 Cassandra 相比，DEPART 将写入和读取吞吐量分别提升至 1.35-1.43× 和 2.26-2.43×。无论集群规模如何，DEPART 都通过副本解耦保持相对于 Cassandra 的性能收益。因此，随着集群规模增大，DEPART 具有良好的可扩展性。

sections.title: 6 Related Work
sections.originalMarkdown:
**Local LSM-tree KV stores.** A number of studies optimize the read and write performance of local LSM-tree KV stores that run on single machines. Read performance can be improved by Bloom filter optimization [23, 38], adaptive caching [65], and scan optimization with succinct tries [68], while write performance can be improved by compaction optimization [24, 32, 55, 56], the fragmented LSM-tree [51], KV separation [12, 36, 43], I/O scheduling optimization [8], memory structure optimization [9], and a mix of optimization techniques for memory-disk-log components [7]. Our work focuses on the replica management in distributed KV stores, and is compatible with the above optimization techniques for local LSM-tree KV stores in individual nodes.

**Distributed KV stores.** Distributed KV stores can be classified into in-memory KV caches [42, 53] and persistent stores [1-3, 41, 50]. Optimization efforts for in-memory KV stores include lock-free and cache-friendly designs for high concurrency and throughput [13, 30, 40], erasure coding designs for memory efficiency [66, 67], self-tuning data placement [49], size-aware sharding for tail latency reduction [26], adaptive load balancing [16], secondary indexing [34], stretched Reed-Solomon coding [35], as well as hot spot optimization [15]. For distributed persistent KV stores, prior studies propose offline index construction for bulk loading [57], adaptive replica selection [52], multi-get scheduling [58], auto-tuning of tail latency optimization [39], load balancing [11], performance optimization via cost-benefit analysis with workload prediction [45], and optimizations of data placement and controlled migration [63, 64]. Persistent KV stores mostly adopt the LSM-tree in the storage layer to store all KV pairs. In contrast, DEPART proposes replica decoupling in distributed LSM-tree KV stores for efficient replica management.

**Replica management.** Prior studies improve the replication of distributed KV stores via efficient replica placement. Early studies include chain replication [61, 62] and its extension [44], low-cost wide-area replication [17], and dynamic hierarchical replication for data grids [46]. Copyset [19] and tiered replication [18] focus on maintaining high storage reliability. Replex [59] supports efficient queries on multiple keys. Our work focuses on the replica management within each storage node, while being compatible with the upper-layer replica placement policies.
sections.translationMarkdown:
**本地 LSM-tree KV 存储。** 大量研究针对运行在单机上的本地 LSM-tree KV 存储，优化其读写性能。读取性能可以通过 Bloom filter 优化 [23, 38]、自适应缓存 [65] 以及使用 succinct trie 的扫描优化 [68] 得到改善；写入性能则可以通过 compaction 优化 [24, 32, 55, 56]、fragmented LSM-tree [51]、KV separation [12, 36, 43]、I/O 调度优化 [8]、内存结构优化 [9]，以及针对 memory-disk-log 组件的混合优化技术 [7] 得到改善。我们的工作关注分布式 KV 存储中的副本管理，并且与上述针对各个节点中本地 LSM-tree KV 存储的优化技术兼容。

**分布式 KV 存储。** 分布式 KV 存储可以分为内存 KV cache [42, 53] 和持久化存储 [1-3, 41, 50]。针对内存 KV 存储的优化工作包括面向高并发和高吞吐量的无锁、cache-friendly 设计 [13, 30, 40]，面向内存效率的纠删码设计 [66, 67]，自调优数据放置 [49]，用于降低尾延迟的大小感知分片 [26]，自适应负载均衡 [16]，二级索引 [34]，扩展 Reed-Solomon 编码 [35]，以及热点优化 [15]。对于分布式持久化 KV 存储，已有研究提出了用于批量加载的离线索引构建 [57]、自适应副本选择 [52]、multi-get 调度 [58]、尾延迟优化的自动调优 [39]、负载均衡 [11]、基于工作负载预测的成本-收益分析性能优化 [45]，以及数据放置和受控迁移优化 [63, 64]。持久化 KV 存储大多在存储层采用 LSM-tree 来存储所有 KV 对。相比之下，DEPART 针对分布式 LSM-tree KV 存储提出了副本解耦，以实现高效的副本管理。

**副本管理。** 以往研究通过高效的副本放置来改进分布式 KV 存储的复制。早期研究包括 chain replication [61, 62] 及其扩展 [44]、低成本广域复制 [17] 以及面向数据网格的动态分层复制 [46]。Copyset [19] 和分层复制 [18] 关注保持较高的存储可靠性。Replex [59] 支持高效的多 key 查询。我们的工作关注每个存储节点内部的副本管理，同时与上层副本放置策略兼容。

sections.title: 7 Conclusion
sections.originalMarkdown: We propose DEPART, which builds on a novel replica management scheme, replica decoupling, for distributed KV stores. DEPART uses a novel two-layer log design with tunable ordering to efficiently manage the redundant copies for different read and write performance requirements. Our DEPART prototype significantly outperforms Cassandra in different types of KV operations and maintains its performance gains for different consistency levels and parameter settings.
sections.translationMarkdown: 我们提出了 DEPART。它面向分布式 KV 存储，构建于一种新颖的副本管理方案——副本解耦之上。DEPART 采用具有可调排序程度的新型双层日志设计，以便针对不同的读写性能需求高效管理 redundant copies。我们的 DEPART 原型在不同类型的 KV 操作中都显著优于 Cassandra，并且在不同一致性级别和参数设置下保持其性能优势。
